sourceRefs.pageTitle: 校园类（对应英语一品质类）
sourceRefs.originalText: Viewed within the context of everyday life, it is hardly surprising that {题目相关词} can bring considerable benefits. First, the exemplary role played by elders in daily conduct enables children to perceive the positive influence of {题目相关词} more directly and to internalize this quality gradually. Second, {题目相关词} allows individuals to cope with difficulties and challenges with greater ease. In addition, those who are long influenced by {题目相关词} tend to develop a clearer understanding of the future and more thoughtful plans for it.

examples.label: 03 年英语一真题（温室花朵）
examples.en: Inside a huge warm house, there is a little and delicate flower, growing vigorously and blossoming, with the house protecting it from the outside severe weather.
examples.zh: 在一个巨大的温室中，有一个小而精致的花朵，在茁壮成长中开花，周围的房子保护着它免受外部的暴风雨。

sourceRefs.pageTitle: 精讲1：温室花朵（03 年）· 六大语法现象与首段描述

examples.label: 04 年英语一真题（终点又是起点）
examples.en: A case in point is Yao Ming, who has been a renowned basketball player. After his retirement, he continued to strive and created his own business.
examples.zh: 一个典型例子就是曾经身为著名篮球运动员的姚明。退役后，他继续奋斗并创建了自己的公司。

sourceRefs.pageTitle: 精讲2：终点又是起点（04 年）· 单图描述与举例论证
sourceRefs.originalText: Life, to my understanding, can be likened to a road with no everlasting success. A case in point is Yao Ming, who has been a renowned basketball player. After his retirement, he continued to strive and created his own business. Actually, there are so many celebrities like Yao.

examples.label: 13 年英语二真题（高校学生兼职）
examples.en: Overall, seniors have the largest proportion of part-time jobs, with 88.24%. Then, the next are juniors and sophomores, at 71.93% and 71.13% respectively. Finally come freshmen, with 67.77%.
examples.zh: 总体上，大四学生拥有最高的兼职比例，达到了88.24%；紧随其后的是大三和大二学生，分别是71.93%和71.13%；排在最后的是大一学生，67.77%。

sourceRefs.pageTitle: 精讲2：高校学生兼职（13 年）· 排序型图表完整骨架
sourceRefs.originalText: Overall, seniors have the largest proportion of part-time jobs, with 88.24%. Then, the next are juniors and sophomores, at 71.93% and 71.13% respectively. Finally come freshmen, with 67.77%. It is also noticeable that over half of students in four grades take part-time jobs.

examples.label: 15 年英语二真题（春节花销饼图）
examples.en: The spending on new-year gifts is the largest proportion, which accounts for 40%, followed by transportation and gathering dinners, with the same 20%.
examples.zh: 新年礼物的花销占比最大，为 40%，其后是交通和聚会吃饭，占比都是 20%。

sourceRefs.pageTitle: 实训2：春假假期花销（15 年）· 饼图排序骨架
sourceRefs.originalText: Given is a pie chart that clearly illustrates the striking contrasts in residents' expense during Spring Festival holidays in a certain city of China. The spending on new-year gifts is the largest proportion, which accounts for 40%, followed by transportation and gathering dinners, with the same 20%. Finally comes the total expenditure on other items, at 20%.

examples.label: 05 年英一真题（辞职+道歉）
examples.en: I am very pleased to recall the past two months when I worked as an editor for your magazine.
examples.zh: 很高兴回想起过去的这两个月，期间我在贵杂志当编辑。

sourceRefs.pageTitle: 精讲1：辞职+道歉（05 年英一）· 首段与主体段
sourceRefs.originalText: I am very pleased to recall the past two months when I worked as an editor for your magazine. However, I am writing for the purpose of quitting, since this work is not what I expected.

examples.label: 13 年英一真题（邀请+说明）

examples.label: 15 年英一真题（推荐新书）
examples.en: it is this book that enables a host of young people, including me, to recognize the significance of peace and the cruelty of war
examples.zh: 正是这本书使得包括我在内的许多年轻人认识到了和平的重要性与战争的残酷

sourceRefs.pageTitle: 15 年英一：推荐+说明 · 推荐书籍骨架
sourceRefs.originalText: To begin with, this book is particularly worth reading and it is characterized by its wonderful story about the war in Afghanistan. In addition, it is this book that enables a host of young people, including me, to recognize the significance of peace and the cruelty of war. Thus, I deem that it is advisable for every club member to read this book, which can bring us power and inspire our passion for the promising life.

Directions: You are to write an email to James Cook, a newly arrived Australian professor, recommending some tourist attractions in your city. Please give reasons for your recommendation. You should write neatly on the ANWSER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use“Li Ming”instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) 例2： 2017 年英语（二） Directions: Suppose you are invited by Professor Williams to give a presentation about Chinese culture to a group of international students. Write a reply to 1)accept the invitation, and 2)introduce the key points of your presentation You should write neatly on the ANWSER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use“Li Ming” instead. Do not write the address. (10 points)小谭

examples.pageText: 例3：2016 年英语（一） 51. Directions: Suppose you are a librarian in your university. Write a notice of about 100 words, providing the newly-enrolled international students with relevant information about the library. You should write neatly on the ANWSER SHEET. Do not sign you own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming” instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) 小作文体裁总结 高频考查类型 书信：Letter/Email 最基础且常见的考查形式 通知：Notice/Announcement 包括书面通知和口头通知，考查频率较高 低频考查类型 海报：Poster 因涉及美术设计，考试不考查美术功底， 故可能性低 简历：Resume 本质是自我介绍，与部分考查内容有重叠 假条：A Request for Leave 因字数限制（通常只需简短说明），考查可 能性小 新增考查类型 会议纪要（minutes）：最新大纲新 增，但可用功能句应对 注意：minutes 与“分钟”同形异义，此处 表示“纪要” 1.2.2 短文写作 例1： 2019 年英语（一）大作文（公众号：学长小谭考研） 52.Directions: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following picture. examples.pageText: 第二章 应用文写作 2.1 审题&简易思路 2.1.1 审题三事项 审题：题目读三遍，否则不动笔 ①背景 ②体裁+内容要求（描述） ③语域（正式I am/非正式I’m）+格式 2.1.2 三段式简易思路 首段1-2 句： a.写给熟人，首句寒暄，二句目的； b.写给陌生人或机构，写自我介绍和目的。 中间段4-6 句： 按题目要求写相应的内容，并辅以感谢、强调、对比、建议、说明等功能表达 完成写作。 尾段1 句： （再次）致歉、感谢、期待、展望等。（整理自：学长小谭） 2.2 石雷鹏老师作文背诵的“七步法” 第一步：抄写范文， 第二步：英译汉， 第三步：汉译英， 第四步：对比找差异， 第五步：专门背写出错或差异之处， 第六步：背写全文至无错， 第七步：举一反三，思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: 参考译文： 这是两副简单但有启发性的图画。在一个巨大的温室中，有一个小而精致的花朵，在茁 壮成长中开花，周围的房子保护着它免受外部的暴风雨。尽管它在温室中看起来健康强壮， 但当这株植物被放置在风雨之中后，很快就枯萎了，花瓣也随风飘零。最后，若干汉字能被 注意到，其内容是“温室的花朵经不起风雨”。 如今的中国家庭的突出特征就在于“一个家庭，一个孩子”。因此，上述场景就能自然 而然地让我们联想到现实生活中的很多家长和他们的孩子。诚然，如今越来越多家长为子女 准备好了几乎所有一切，例如吃、穿、住房、学费、婚姻甚至未来的工作。这种现象很值得 关注，原因是父母极为关注自己孩子的舒适和享受，忽略了独立对于年轻人的重要性。正是 父母的过度保护使得年轻人没有积累足够的能力或自信去面对社会。（整理自：学长小谭） 然而，在我看来，独立能够被比喻成一条通向成功的道路。作为一种重要的素质，独立 会带给年轻人力量，唤起他们对生活的热爱，帮助他们赢得未来的社会竞争。不幸的是，就 像温室一样，一些家长盲目的爱已经构成了一种障碍，阻碍着孩子们的成长。 因此，整个社会应该营造一个积极的氛围，去批判家长对孩子盲目的爱。而且，家长应 该给孩子提供独立成长的自由和机会。总之，所有家长都应该牢记：他们保护不了孩子一生 一世。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: ③这种现象是很值得关注的，因为他们之中的一些人只关注明星肤浅的生活方式，无视学习明 星优点的重要性。 This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that some of them focus merely on stars’ superficial lifestyles, ignoring/overlooking the significance of learning their merits/strong points/virtues or excellent qualities. 二段继续： ①不幸的是，这种盲目的喜爱可能会构成一种障碍，将阻碍他们长期的成长和进步。 Unfortunately, this sort of blind worship may constituted an obstacle that will hinder their long- term growth and progress. ②事实上，我们应该学习积极的榜样，他们会带给我们正确的方向，会唤起我们奋斗的热情， 会帮助我们提升自己。 As a matter of fact, it is advisable for us to learn from positive examples, which can bring us right directions, arouse/inspire our passion for striving and help us enhance ourselves. 尾段： ①在我看来，一个积极的偶像能被比喻成黑暗之中的光，引领我们走向光明未来。 To my understanding, a positive idol can be likened to light in the dark, directing/guiding us to a promising future. ②因此，我们作为年轻人，应该有自己的偶像，而且我们很有必要去学习他们的优点，例如勤 奋、持之以恒、自信、乐观。 Accordingly, as youngsters, we are supposed to have our own idols, and it is exceedingly necessary for us to learn their virtues or merits, such as diligence, perseverance/persistence, confidence and optimism. 参考范文： Obviously, these two photos look ridiculous at the first sight but thought-provoking on the second thought. The guy in the left one is characterized by his distinctive face, with name “BECKHAM” on it. The youngster in the right photo sits in a chair, spending 300 yuan designing his hairstyle as cool as Beckham’s. Such two persons can be associated with a host of boys and girls who are crazy fans of stars. They are fascinated by various celebrities, such as champions in sports, pop singers, renowned actors and so forth. However, some of them focus eyesight only on stars’ superficial lifestyles, ignoring their merits. This sort of blind worship may constitute an obstacle, hindering young people’s progress and growth. A positive idol, to my understanding, can be likened to a lamp, guiding us. It is advisable for us, as teenagers, to have our own idols, but it is of greater necessity for us to learn their virtues, like diligence, perseverance, strong wills and the faith. In this manner, we can better ourselves. (173words) 参考译文： 显然，这两幅照片第一眼看上去很可笑，但再一想还是值得深思。左图中的年轻人最突 出的特征就在于他的那张写有“BECKHAM”字样的脸。右图中的年轻人 则坐在椅子上， 花300 元设计了一个跟贝克汉姆的发型一样帅气的头型。 这两位能自然联系到现实生活中很多对明星很疯狂的少男少女。他们深深喜爱着各种名 人，如体育冠军、流行歌手、著名演员等。然而，有些人却只关注了这些明星肤浅的生活方

(221 words) temporary adj.暂时的 参考译文： 首先，几个汉字阐述了图画的寓意：终点又是起点。接下来，让我们仔细观察一下图片 吧！在一条跑道上，有一个自信的运动员，冲向比赛的终点，脸上洋溢着乐观的笑容。尽管 已经很累了，但他还是立即开始了他的下一个目标。（整理自：学长小谭） 上述场景能自然使我们联系到现实生活中很多的成功人士。他们在各自的领域取得成功 后，并未满足或骄傲。相反，他们立即设定了更大的目标。这种美德值得赞扬，因为正是他 们的持之以恒使得他们一次次成功。 在我看来，人生能够被比喻成一条路，这条路上没有永恒的成功。一个典型例子就是曾 经身为著名篮球运动员的姚明。退役后，他继续奋斗并创建了自己的公司。事实上，像姚明 这样的名人很多很多。 每个人都应该牢记：任何成功都是暂时的。因此，整个社会应该营造积极氛围，去拒绝并批 判那些因为小的成功而产生的骄傲和满足。同时，作为年轻人的我们应该通过为更大目标持 续奋斗来提升自我。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that these people may be addicted to/indulge themselves in the virtual world, ignoring their friends and family members in reality. ③正是网络缩短了距离，但也正是网络导致人际关系变得冷漠或疏远。 It is the Internet that shortens the distance, but it is (also) the Internet that causes the interpersonal relation(ship) to become indifferent/cold or "far". 二段继续： ①因此，网络，在我看来，能被比喻成一把双刃剑。 Thus, the Internet, to my understanding, can be likened to a double-edged sword. ②一方面，它能带给我们巨大的方便，帮我们消除了距离方面的障碍。 On the one hand, it can bring us tremendous convenience, and help us remove/get rid of =eliminate the barrier in distance.（整理自：学长小谭） ③另一方面，互联网已经构成了一种障碍，阻碍着人类的正常交流。 On the other hand, the Internet has constituted an obstacle that hinders humans' normal communication. 尾段： ①总之，作为一个年轻人，我认为我们应该以理性的方式来使用互联网。 In a nutshell, as a youngster, I am convinced that it is advisable for us to use/utilize the Internet in a rational/sensible=appropriately manner. ②此外，我们应该牢记，网络只是一个工具。 So, we are well-advised to bear in mind that the Internet is just/only/ merely a tool. ③我们不能变成包括网络、手机在内的任何科技产品的奴隶， We can never ... =Never can we become slaves to/of any scientific product, including the Internet and cell phones. 参考范文： Inside a huge spider-net, there are hundreds of individuals at different ages, sitting in front of computers and surfing the Internet. Although they are quite near, these web surfers never chat face to face. Meanwhile, several Chinese characters can be noticed, which say that the online distance is “far” as well as “near”. Such a scene above is particularly worth concerning for the reason that some people may spend much time on the virtual world—the Internet, totally turning a blind eye to their friends or families in reality. It is the Internet that shortens the distance, but it is also the Internet that causes the interpersonal relation to be “far” in real life. To my understanding, the Internet can be likened to a double-edged sword. On the one hand, it indefinitely brings us convenience and helps us remove the barrier in distance. On the other hand, unfortunately, youngsters in large numbers may be addicted to online games, and thus, the Internet has constituted an obstacle that hinders humans’ normal communication. As a college student, I am convinced that it is of great necessity for young people to utilize the Internet appropriately. What we should bear in mind is that the Internet is merely a tool. Thus, never can we become slaves of any scientific products, including the Internet and cell phones. 参考译文： 一个巨大的蜘蛛网里，有着不同年龄段的很多人，他们坐在电脑前上网。尽管他们很近，

Although they are quite near, these web surfers never chat face to face. Internet, totally turning a blind eye to their friends or families in reality. To my understanding, the Internet can be likened to a double-edged sword. On the one hand, it indefinitely brings us convenience and helps us remove the barrier in distance. As a college student, I am convinced that it is of great necessity for young people to utilize the Internet appropriately. What we should bear in mind is that the Internet is merely a tool. Thus, never can we become slaves of any scientific products, including the Internet and cell phones.

examples.pageText: 但这些上网者几乎没有面对面的交谈。同时，能注意到几个汉字，其内容是：网络距离是“近 的”也是“远的”。 上述场景很值得关注，因为一些人可能花了太多时间在网络这种虚拟的世界里，完全无 视现实中的家人和朋友。正是网络缩短距离，但也正是网络使得现实生活中正常的人际关系 变得疏远。 在我看来，互联网能被比喻成一把双刃剑。一方面，它确实带给我们便利，帮助我们消 除了距离方面的障碍。另一方面，不幸的是，很多年轻人可能沉溺于网络游戏。因此，互联 网就成为一种阻碍人们正常交往的障碍。（整理自：学长小谭） 作为一名大学生，我认为年轻人很有必要理性使用互联网。我们应该牢记的是网络只是 一种工具。因此，我们不能成为包括互联网和手机在内的任何科技产品的奴隶。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

The right cartoon is a case in point. 二段继续： ①另一方面，子女也需要父母的爱和保护。正是父母的关心使得年轻人健康快乐的成长。 On the other hand/For another hand, it is parents' love and protection that enable their kids to enjoy/have/get happiness and the joy/delight/pleasure of growing. ②总之，不得不承认，越来越多家庭都在尽全力为老人和孩子营造这种和谐美好的氛围。 To conclude/In conclusion/In a nutshell, admittedly, an increasing number of families are doing their best/utmost(making every effort) to foster/create/make this sort of nice and harmonious atmosphere for both children and aged parents. 尾段： ①作为一个年轻人，我坚信中国的每个家庭都应该保持这些传统美德。 As a youngster, I am convinced that it is advisable for every family to preserve/follow /continue/inherit/keep/maintain these traditional virtues. ②因此，年轻人应该多挤时间去陪伴上了年纪的父母，无论自己有多忙。 Accordingly, young people are supposed to/well-advised to spare/spend more time to accompany the aged parents, no matter how busy they/we are. 参考范文： The above drawings emphasize the harmony and happiness of a mother and her daughter. Three decades ago, the young mother held her little lovely angel's hand, walking on a road, with sweet smiles on their faces. Now, although the mom becomes aged and the daughter has grown up, they still enjoy the same happiness. Finally, two Chinese characters interpret the intended meaning, namely, "mutual supporting". This common scene is particularly worth attention for the reason that the drawer focuses on the traditional Chinese virtues filial piety and loving kids, which characterize a happy family. Filial piety brings the aged parents power, arouses their enthusiasm for life and helps them enjoy their twilight. Meanwhile, intelligent parents in large numbers have realized the significance of loving children. Thus, it has become a common expectation for a host of families in China to forge a harmonious atmosphere for both children and aged parents. It is their mutual supporting that enables both the young and the senior to acquire long-time happiness. A case in point the mother and her daughter in the pictures. As a college student, I am convinced that it is of vital necessity for every family in China to preserve this traditional virtue. Accordingly, it is advisable for youngsters to spare adequate time to accompany their old parents, no matter how busy they are, because without parents’ supporting, it is impossible for young people to grow up. 参考译文： 上图展示了一位妈妈和女儿的幸福与和谐。30 年前，年轻的妈妈握着自己可爱 的小天 使的手走在路上，笑容满面。如今，尽管妈妈已经年迈女儿已长大成人，她 们依旧享受同 样的幸福。最后，两个汉字解释了图片的寓意——“相携”。 这种常见的情景尤其值得关注，因为图画的作者关注的是传统的中国美德：尊老爱幼， 这是幸福家庭的显著特征。孝心带给年老的父母力量，唤起他们对生活的热爱，帮助他们安 度晚年。同时，明智的家长都意识到爱子女的重要性。因此，很多中国家庭都普遍期待为老

As a college student, I am convinced that it is of vital necessity for every family in China to preserve this traditional virtue.

Although these people/guys/individuals get together/gather to enhance friendship, scarcely do they communicate/chat/talk with each other/they scarcely talk with each other. 二段： ①这样一个可笑的场景，显然，能被联系到手机对现代生活造成的消极影响。 Such a ridiculous and sarcastic scenario, apparently, can be associated with the negative/bad/ terrible/awful influences of cell phones upon/on the modern life. ②不得不承认，如今，越来越多青少年把太多时间花费在手机上看视频、购物、上网、打游戏 或聊天。（整理自：学长小谭） Admittedly, now, an increasing number of teenagers spend too much/excessive time on smart phones to watch videos, shop online, surf the Internet, play games or chat with others. ③这种现象是非常值得关注的，因为一些人可能沉溺于网络这个虚拟的时间，忽略了现实生活 中的朋友或家人。 This phenomenon/trend/fact is particularly worth attention for the reason that some people may be addicted to/indulge themselves in the virtual world-the Internet/the cyberspace, ignoring the friends and family members in reality. 二段继续： ①一个典型例子就是图画中的场景。 A case in point is the scene in the picture. ②事实上，手机的过度使用已经构成了一种障碍，阻碍着人们之间的正常交流。 As a matter of fact, the excessive use of cell phones has constituted an obstacle that hinder people's normal communication. 尾段： 作为一个年轻人，我认为，每个人都应该牢牢记住：手机只是工具而已。同时，我们应该理性 使用包括手机、网络和计算机在内的科技产品。 In a nutshell, all phone users are well-advised to/supposed to bear/keep in mind that smart phones are just/merely tools. Thus, it is not advisable for us to become slaves to any technological product(s). Instead, it is quite/exceedingly necessary for us to rationally use cell phones, computers, the Internet and the like. 参考范文： This is a simple but enlightening cartoon beside a table sit four youngsters, staring at their smart cell phones, with tasty foods uneaten. Although they gather to enhance friendship, scarcely do these guys chat with each other. Finally, several Chinese characters are given, which say "dinning together in the era of cell phones". Such a scenario, apparently, can be associated with the excessive use of cell phones among teenagers. As a matter of fact, cell phones have constituted an obstacle that hinders people's normal communication. A case in point is that a host of youngsters, like the guys in the picture, spend much time on mobile phones to surf the Internet, chat with friends or comment others’ We-chats. This trend is particularly worth attention for the reason that they are addicted to the virtual world, ignoring the real life. （整理自：学长小谭） All phone users should bear in mind that cell phones are just tools. I am convinced that it is not advisable for youngsters to be slave of mobile phones. Accordingly, we should utilize modern technological products rationally, including the Internet, cell phones, TV and computers.

examples.pageText: 参考译文： 这是一幅简单但有启发性的漫画：在一餐桌旁边坐着四位年轻人，他们盯着自己的智能 手机，桌子上的美味食物丝毫未动。尽管他们为了友情而聚餐，但他们几乎没有交流。最后， 还给了几个汉字，内容为“手机时代的聚餐”。 显然，这种情节能自然联系到手机在年轻人中的过度使用。事实上，手机已经构成一种 障碍，阻碍着人们的正常交流。一个典型例子：像图画中的年轻人一样，很多年轻人花费太 多时间在手机上网、聊天或其评论他人的微信。这种趋势很值得。关注，因为他们沉溺于虚 拟的世界，忽略了真实生活。 所有手机用户应该牢记：手机只是工具。我认为年轻人当手机的奴隶是不明智的。因此， 我们应该理性使用现代科技产品，像网络、手机、电视和计算机等。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

In your essay you should 1) describe the drawing briefly 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points) 与其只提要求，不好做个榜样 • 细节把握： o 文字气泡指向表明说话者身份 o 关键提示语：“与其只提要求，不如做个榜样” • 常见误区： o 错误理解人物关系（如误认儿子命令父亲） o 过度解读图画细节（如父亲手持物品） o 偏离核心主旨（如讨论母亲角色缺失） 课堂练笔： 首段： ①在左边的漫画中，有一个爸爸，悠闲地坐在电视机前，看着电视节目同时督促自己的儿子好 好学习，但孩子没有任何行动。 In the left cartoon, there is a father/dad leisurely sitting in front of a TV set, watching TV programs and urging/asking/requiring his son to work study/learn but the teenager takes no action/does not take any action. ②相反，在右图中，尽管这位父亲不再要求自己的孩子学的，但孩子却专心看书，当爸爸开始 学习。最后，若干汉字能被注意到，其内容是：与其只提要求做个榜样。 By contrast, in the right drawing, although the father does not require his child to learn, the boy focuses on reading when his dad begins to learn. Finally, several Chinese characters can be noticed, which be noticed， which say that it is advisable for parents to become good examples. 二段： ①这样的场景，显然，能被联系到现实中很荒唐不负责任的家长和他们的可笑行为。 Such scenarios/scenes/drawings, apparently, definitely/evidently/with no doubt/undoubtedly can be associated with a host of absurd irresponsible parents and their ridiculous behaviors in reality. ②不得不承认，如今，很多家长都期待自己的孩子在学习方面变得优秀或突出，然而他们却给 孩子树立不好的榜样。 Admittedly, at present/today/nowadays/now, a large number of parents expect/wish/anticipate that their children become excellent or outstanding/can excel or outstand in academic performance /pursuit, but they tend to set bad/negative/terrible/awful examples for the kids. ③这种现象是很值得关注，因为一些父母把只关注自己的舒适享乐，忽略了对孩子的影响。

examples.pageText: This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that some fathers or mothers just focus on their own comfort and enjoyment, ignoring the impacts/influences/effects on/ upon the young. 二段继续： ①因此，在我看来，父母应该成为孩子最好的老师。 Thus/Accordingly/Therefore/Hence, to my understanding/in my opinion, parents are supposed to be the best teachers for the children. ②作为积极的榜样，负责的父母应该给孩子带来清晰的方向，激发他们奋斗的热情，并陪伴孩 子健康成长。 As positive role models, responsible parents should bring children clear directions, inspire their passion for striving, and accompany them in growing up healthily. 尾段： 总之，整个社会应该营造积极氛围去教育和鼓励所有家长通过自身的恰当做法为孩子树立好 的榜样。 In a nutshell/To conclude/In conclusion/In a word/To sum up, society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to encourage and educate all parents to set good examples for children by behaving appropriately. 参考范文： In the first cartoon, there is a father, sitting in front of a computer, playing games and urging his son to work hard, but the youngster takes no action. By contrast, in the second one, although the father does not require his kid to study, the child concentrates on learning when his dad begins to learn. Finally, several Chinese characters can be noticed, which say that instead of merely requiring, parents should be models for children. These two pictures are particularly worth concerning for the reason that they focus on how parents should educate their kids in life and study. In contemporary China, it has become a trend for an increasing number of parents to demand their teenagers to work hard for academic success, but they set negative examples. A case in point is the father in the left picture. To my understanding, the strength of role models is infinite. As positive models, parents bring kids power, arouse their enthusiasm for study and help them to grow healthily. Unfortunately, many parents’ bad behaviors have constituted an obstacle that hinders kids' growth and progress. （整理自：学长小谭） As a college student, I am convinced that it is of great necessity for parents to enhance their positive impacts on children by behaving appropriately. Meanwhile, the society as a whole should forge a positive atmosphere to criticize and reject parents’ negative examples for kids. 参考译文： 在第一个图中，一个父亲坐在电脑前打游戏并鼓励自己的儿子努力学习，但是孩子没有 任何行动。相反，在第二个图中，当爸爸也开始学习时，尽管他不再要求孩子学习，孩子反 而专心学习了。最后，能注意到若干汉字，其内容为“与其只提要求，不如做个榜样。” 这样的两幅图很值得注意，因为其关注的是父母在生活和学习中如何教育孩子。在当今 中国，越来越多家长要求孩子努力取得学习的成功，但他们却给孩子树立负面的榜样。典型 例子就是左图中的爸爸。在我理解，榜样的力量是无穷的。作为积极的榜样，父母带给孩子 力量，唤起他们对生活的热情，帮助他们健康成长。不幸的是，很多家长的负面行为已经构

A case in point is the father in the left picture. To my understanding, the strength of role models is infinite. As positive models, parents bring kids power, arouse their enthusiasm for study and help them to grow healthily. As a college student, I am convinced that it is of great necessity for parents to enhance their positive impacts on children by behaving appropriately.

examples.pageText: 17 年英语一：“有书”与“读书” Directions：Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay you should 1) describe the drawing briefly 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points) “有书”与“读书” • 图画信息： o 对比分析： ▪ 左图人物拥有大量书籍却不阅读（炫耀姿态） ▪ 右图人物虽书少但制定明确阅读计划（20 本/年） o 细节描写： ▪ 需包含人物神态（悠闲vs 专注）、动作（炫耀vs 阅读）、环境（沙发vs 书桌）等要素 • 文字说明： o 主题提炼："有书"与"读书"的对比揭示核心论点：行动比拥有更重要 o 延伸立意：可拓展至学习态度（买课不听vs 坚持学习）、生活态度（空想vs 实践）等层面 o 现实映射：批判"形式主义学习"现象（购书不读/报课不学/立志不行动） 课堂练笔： 首段： ①这是一组简单但具有启发性的漫画。 These are a set of/two simple but enlightening/thought-provoking cartoons. ②在左图中，有一个年轻人，悠闲地坐在一个椅子上，炫耀自己的很多书，手里一本也没有。 In the left one, there is a youngster, leisurely sitting in a chair and boasting/flaunting/showing off his large number of/plenty/lots books, with no book in his hands. ③然而，在右图中，另一年轻人已经下定决心尽最大努力今年读20 本书。 However/By contrast, in the right drawing, the other young man has made up his mind to do his utmost to read 20 books this year.（整理自：学长小谭）. ④最后，若干汉字能被注意到，其内容是:“有书”与“读书”。 Finally, several Chinese characters can be noticed, which say “having(=owing/possessing) books” and “reading books”. 二段： ①上述场景，显然，能被联系到现实中对待图书两种截然不同的态度。 Such scenarios/scenes/pictures, apparently/evidently/obviously/definitely/with no doubt= undoubtedly, can be associated with two distinct/ different attitudes toward(s)books in reality/in the real life. ②不得不承认，如今，很多人往往会买书、藏书甚至炫耀自己的书，但他们从来不读书。

examples.pageText: Admittedly, now, a host of individuals tend to purchase store and even show off their books, but they have never read any book. ③这种现象是非常值得关注而且很可笑。因此，每个人都应该牢牢记住：书适应被读而不是被 炫耀。 This phenomenon is particularly worth attention and ridiculous/absurd/sarcastic/satirical. Thus, everyone is supposed to bear in mind that books should be read and not be flaunted. 二段继续： ①作为一个好习惯，读书能带给我们丰富的知识，激发我们对美好未来的热情，帮我们拓宽视 野。 As a good habit, reading books can bring/give us rich/abundant/ample/affluent knowledge, inspire our passion for the promising future, and help us broaden our horizons. ②事实上，正是阅读使得我们积累了自信、乐观和勇气去迎接各种桃战。 As a matter of fact, it is reading that also enables us to accumulate adequate confidence, optimism and courage to meet a variety of challenges. 尾段： 作为一个大学生，我认为，整个社会应该营造积极氛围来教育和鼓励人们不仅要要买书，还要 专心读书。 As a college student, I am convinced that/I cling to the idea that society as a whole/people should foster a positive atmosphere to educate and encourage all citizens to not only buy and store books, but also be absorbed in/concentrate on/focus on reading books. 参考范文： In the first cartoon, there is a youngster, sitting leisurely in a chair and flaunting his large number of books, with no book in hands. However, in the right picture, although the guy has just a few books, he has made his mind to do his utmost to read 20 books in this year. Several Chinese characters, finally, can be noticed, which say “having books” and “reading books”. These two pictures are particularly worth concerning for the reason that the painter focuses his eyesight on what the true reading is. In the contemporary society, a host of people prefer to purchase, store and even flaunt their books, but they may never read any books. This phenomenon is rather ridiculous. As a matter of fact, everyone should bear in mind that books should be read and not be boasted. Reading books, as a positive habit, brings us knowledge, arouses our enthusiasm for future life and enhances our quality. It is books that enable us to acquire not only knowledge, but also confidence, optimism and courage to face any adversity. I, as a college student, am convinced that the society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to educate and encourage all people to not only purchase books, but also to be absorbed in reading books. 参考译文： 在第一幅漫画中，有一个年轻人，悠闲地坐在沙发上炫耀自己海量的藏书，手里却一本 书都没有。然而，在右图中，尽管那位小伙只有几本书，但他却下定决心 要尽全力一年内 读20 本书。最后，能注意到几个汉字，其内容是：“有书”与“读书”。 这两幅图片很值得关注，因为画家关注的是什么是真正的阅读。在当今社会, 很多人喜 欢买书、藏书、甚至炫耀书，但他们从来不读书。这种现象是可笑的。事实上，每个人都应 该牢记：书是用来读的不是用来吹牛皮的。作为一种好习惯，读书会带给我们知识，唤起我

Thus, everyone is supposed to bear in mind that books should be read and not be flaunted. As a matter of fact, it is reading that also enables us to accumulate adequate confidence, optimism and courage to meet a variety of challenges. In the first cartoon, there is a youngster, sitting leisurely in a chair and flaunting his large number of books, with no book in hands. However, in the right picture, although the guy has just a few books, he has made his mind to do his utmost to read 20 books in this year. These two pictures are particularly worth concerning for the reason that the painter focuses his eyesight on what the true reading is. In the contemporary society, a host of people prefer to purchase, store and even flaunt their books, but they may never read any books. As a matter of fact, everyone should bear in mind that books should be read and not be boasted. Reading books, as a positive habit, brings us knowledge, arouses our enthusiasm for future life and enhances our quality. It is books that enable us to acquire not only knowledge, but also confidence, optimism and courage to face any adversity. I, as a college student, am convinced that the society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to educate and encourage all people to not only purchase books, but also to be absorbed in reading books.

examples.pageText: tend to choose the second kind of course, ignoring the significance of enhancing themselves. ②事实上，他们这种短视且肤浅的选择可能会构成一种障碍，阻碍着他们的长期进步和成长。 In fact/Actually/As a matter of fact, their short-sighted and superficial choice may constitute/ form/become obstacle that/which hinders/impairs/undermines their long-term progress and growth. ③因此，聪明的学生都应该选择具有挑战性、有最新知识和创新精神的课程，这些课程会带他 们更强的动力，激发他们奋斗的热情，并帮助他们拓宽视野。 Thus, intelligent students are supposed to take challenging electives with the latest/up-to-date knowledge and innovative spirit, which can bring/give them greater motivation, inspire their passion for striving, and help them broaden their horizons. 二段选写： （我就是一个很好的例子，我更喜欢这些创新课程，因为我相信创新可以被比作/就像是通往 美好未来的旅程。） I am a case in point and I prefer these innovative courses, because I am convinced that innovation can be likened to/is just like a journey leading to a promising future. 尾段： 总之，整个社会应该营造积极氛围去鼓励年轻人挑战自我、追求最新和培养创新能力，目的是 适应社会的飞速发展。 In a nutshell/In conclusion/To conclude/To sum up, society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to encourage young people to challenge themselves, pursue the latest knowledge, and cultivate/develop=nurture innovative ability for the purpose of adapting science to the fast pace of/rapid development of society, science and technology. 参考范文： A youngster sits in front of a course selection system, pondering over two groups of characteristics-the right one includes easy access to high scores, less difficulties in passing the test and less assignments; the left one involves the latest knowledge, emphasis on innovation or more challenging requirements. Finally, several Chinese characters can be noticed, which say that it is time to choose the elective. （整理自：学长小谭） Such a scenario is particularly worth attention for the reason that some students may focus much on the so-called "ease", ignoring what they can acquire. As a matter of fact, their short- sighted behaviors have constituted an obstacle that hinders their growth and progress. On the contrary, intelligent students are convinced that it is of great necessity for them to take challenging electives with the latest knowledge and innovative spirit. Why? The contemporary society is best characterized by the speedy development of science and technology. Then, it is by acquiring the latest knowledge that they can keep up with the fast pace of social advancement. In addition, they believe that innovation can be likened to a bridge, leading to a more promising future. I prefer challenging tasks, since these courses, to my understanding, can bring me motivation to learn, arouse my passion for academic success and help me broaden my horizons. 参考译文： 一个年轻人坐在选课系统班的前面，思考着两组特征——右边这组包括“给高分、易通 过、作业少”；左边的这组涉及“知识新、重创新、有难度”。最后，可以注意到几个汉字， 其内容是“选课进行时”。

In your essay you should 1) describe the drawing briefly 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points) • 观察要点：题目解析 o 开头方式1: "This is a simple but enlightening cartoon..." o 开头方式2: "Two Chinese characters can be noticed..." o 开头方式3: "The cartoon obviously reminds us of..." o 共同特点: 均可作为文章首句，后续接具体描述 • 写作思路（多元路径）： o 比喻路径（坚持如登山） o 现象分析（年轻人易放弃） o 对比论证（两种态度差异） o 统一要求：最终都需回归图画描述 • 段落示范： o 概述图画主题 o 分述人物行为（放弃者+鼓励者） o 点明文字说明 课堂练笔： 首段： ①这幅漫画，显然，能被联系到对于挫折/困难两种截然不同的态度。 This drawing/cartoon/picture, apparently/obviously/evidently/definitely/undoubtedly, can be associated with/related/linked to two distinct/totally/completely attitudes towards setbacks or difficulties. （整理自：学长小谭） ②具体来讲，在一条通往大山的路上，有一个年轻人，坐着休息的同时感叹道，“累了，我不 爬了。" To be specific, on a road/path/journey/way to a high mountain, there is a youngster, sitting for a rest and sighing/saying/commenting/complaining, “I am too tired/exhausted to climb/go on”. ③与之相反的是，他的伙伴意志力更坚强，鼓励他休息后继续，尽管他们都很累。 By contrast, his partner's/friend’s will is stronger, encouraging him to continue after the rest, although they are tired to the same extent. ④最后，两个汉字能被注意到，其内容是：途中。

examples.pageText: 显然，该图能联想到面对逆境时的两种截然不同的态度。为什么哪？接下来，让我们仔 细观察一下图片吧！在一条通往大山的路上，有一个年轻人，坐着休息的同时还叹气道，“累 了，我不爬了。”相反，他同伴鼓励他休息后继续坚持。最后，我们注意到两个汉字，内容 是“途中”。 成功人士的特征就在于他们身上包括坚强的意志力和持之以恒在内的各种优秀素质。然 而，在现实生活中，很多年轻人在追求成功的过程中遭遇挑战时往往会放弃。这种现象非常 值得关注。在我看来，坚持就是成功之路。一个典型的例子就是我自己。作为一个正在准备 研究生人学考试的大四同学，我坚信持之以恒带给我力量，唤起我对未来的想往，帮我克服 了如此多困难。 事实上，“放弃”这种想法已经构成了一种障碍，阻碍着很多人在工作、生活和学习中 的成长和进步。因此，每个人都应牢记：永不放弃，你才会最终实现梦想。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

(20 points) • 题目解析： o 图画要素： ▪ 美猴王与独臂男子的跨时空对话 ▪ 残疾特征暗示坚持的难度 o 文字关键： ▪ 孩子在意他人评价（"同学觉得不好玩"） ▪ 父亲强调自我认同（"自己喜欢就够了"） o 核心立意： ▪ 坚持个人兴趣不受外界影响 ▪ 非简单传统文化主题 o 易错点： ▪ 过度解读神话元素 ▪ 忽略父子对话的价值观冲突 课堂练笔： 首段： ①这是一幅简单但具有启发性的漫画，在漫画中有一个可爱的小男孩，穿着美猴王的戏服，脸 上满是困惑/失望（可省略），抱怨道，“爸爸，好多同学觉得学唱戏不好玩。” This is a simple but enlightening cartoon, in which there is a little and lovely boy, wearing the costume the Monkey King, with great confusion/perplexity/disappointment on his face, complaining, “Dad, many classmates think/deem that it's boring to learn/play the opera.” ②然后，他的爸爸鼓励他,“你不是自己喜欢吗？那就足够了？” Then, his father encourages/inspires him, “Don't you like it? That's enough”(his father encourages him to do what he likes).（整理自：学长小谭） 二段： ①成功人士的突出特征就在于他们的各种优秀品质，例如勤奋、乐观、自信和坚持自己的想 法。 Successful people/figures/celebrities=High achievers characterized by Successful individuals are featured with their various excellent qualities, such as diligence, optimism, confidence and persisting in their own thoughts/ideas/opinions.

examples.pageText: 这是一幅简单但有启发性的漫画。图画中，有个年轻人，很失望地抱怨说：“我想学戏 曲，但朋友说这很无趣。”然后，他的爸爸就鼓励他，说：“你喜欢，才是最重要的。” 显然，这位父亲的鼓励能联系到一个人坚持梦想的重要性。在我看来，成功人士的突出 特征就在于他们身上的各种优点，例如乐观、自信、勤奋和独立思考。然而，在现实中，很 多年轻人跟图画中的小男孩很像，他们经常受到他人观念的影响甚至会放弃自己真正想要 的。这种现象非常值得关注，因为他们过于关注的是别人说什么，忽略了坚持自己梦想的重 要性。事实上，这种消极的心态已经构成了一种障碍，阻碍着他们的进步和成长。 作为一名大学生，我认为我们很有必要去做自己喜欢的事，这会带给我们动力，唤起我 们对奋斗的热情渴望，帮助我们最终实现梦想。每个人都应该记住：引领通向我们成功和美 好未来的是我们的坚持而不是别人的评论。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: 这将会带给我们力量，激发我们对学习的热情，并帮助我们拓宽视野/提升竞争力。 Thus, as a college student, I deem that it is advisable for teenagers/young people to gain various experience and competence by listening to all kinds of lectures or courses, which will bring/give us power, inspire our passion for learning, and help us broaden our horizons/enhance our competitive- edge. 尾段： ①总之，每个人都应该牢记，知识能被比喻成一个宝藏或通向光明未来的道路。 In conclusion=All in all=In a word=To sum up/In a nutshell, everyone is supposed to bear in mind that knowledge can be likened to/is just like a treasure or a journey leading to the promising future. ②与此同时，整个社会应该营造积极氛围去鼓励和教育公民阅读各种图书，听各种讲座，如果 时间允许的话（在其空闲时间）。 Meanwhile, society as a whole should foster a positive/good/nice atmosphere to encourage and educate all citizens to read a variety of books and attend various lectures in the spare time(if time is available). 参考范文： Such a cartoon, apparently, can be associated with two distinct attitudes towards learning. Why? Let us observe it closely. Beside a bulletin board, there is a girl, pointing at the board and commenting "This lecture is not concerning our major and it is worthless to listen to it." However, the other girl, with short hair, says "It is definitely good to learn something!” Successful figures, to my understanding, are characterized by their various merits, such as diligence, optimism, curiosity and positive attitude towards learning. Nonetheless, in reality, a host of youngsters are reluctant to acquire knowledge or skills beyond their majors. As a matter of fact, this shortsighted behavior has constituted an obstacle that hinders young people's growth and progress in personal development. As a college student, I deem that it is of great necessity for us to gain various experience and competence, which may bring us power, arouse our passion for life and help us broaden our horizons. Accordingly, society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to educate and encourage teenagers to read diverse books and attend sorts of lectures if time and energy is available. Everyone should bear in mind that knowledge is power, treasure and the journey to a promising future. 参考译文： 这样一幅漫画，显然，能让我们想到两种截然不同的学习态度。为什么？让我们仔细观 察一下图片。在一个布告栏旁，有一个女孩指着布告栏说：“这讲座与我们的专业无关，听 也没用。”然而，另一个留着短发、戴着帽子的女孩说：“学点东西肯定很好呀！” 在我看来，成功人士突出特征就在于他们的各种优点，如勤奋、乐观、好奇和积极的学 习态度。然而，在现实中，许多年轻人不愿意获得专业以外的知识或技能。事实上，这种短 视的行为已经成为阻碍年轻人成长和个人发展进步的障碍。作为一名大学生，我认为获得各 种经验和能力是非常必要的，这些经验和能力可以给我们带来力量，激发我们对生活的热情， 帮助我们开阔视野。 因此，整个社会应该营造一种积极的氛围，教育和鼓励青少年在时间和精力允许的情况 下阅读各种书籍和听各种讲座。每个人都应该记住，知识是力量、是财富、是通往光明未来 的道路。
examples.en: Such a cartoon, apparently, can be associated with two distinct attitudes towards learning. Beside a bulletin board, there is a girl, pointing at the board and commenting "This lecture is not concerning our major and it is worthless to listen to it. However, the other girl, with short hair, says "It is definitely good to learn something! Successful figures, to my understanding, are characterized by their various merits, such as diligence, optimism, curiosity and positive attitude towards learning. Nonetheless, in reality, a host of youngsters are reluctant to acquire knowledge or skills beyond their majors. As a matter of fact, this shortsighted behavior has constituted an obstacle that hinders young people's growth and progress in personal development. As a college student, I deem that it is of great necessity for us to gain various experience and competence, which may bring us power, arouse our passion for life and help us broaden our horizons. Accordingly, society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to educate and encourage teenagers to read diverse books and attend sorts of lectures if time and energy is available. Everyone should bear in mind that knowledge is power, treasure and the journey to a promising future.

examples.pageText: ③一个典型例子就是漫画中的龙舟比赛。正是这个比赛使得很多的青少年知道了屈原和他伟 大爱国精神。 A case in point is the dragon boat race in the drawing. It is this competition that enables a host of teenagers to know Qu Yuan and his great patriotism. 尾段： ①总之，整个社会应该营造积极氛围来鼓励和教育年轻人参加传统文化活动。 In a nutshell/To conclude=ln conclusion=To sum up, I am convinced that society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to educate and encourage youngsters to participate in traditional cultural activities. ②此外，每个人都应该牢记：我们的历史和文化是我们民族之根。 In addition, it is advisable for everyone to bear in mind that our history and culture is the root of our nation. 参考范文： In a river, there is a dragon boat race, with thousands of villagers standing around and cheering up. Meanwhile, it can be noticed that a grandma is talking with a grandpa" Amazing, the dragon boat race in our village is becoming increasingly lively. " China is characterized by its time-honored history and diverse cultural traditions, such as the Dragon Boat Festival, the Mid-Autumn Festival and the Spring Festival. To preserve the cultural heritage, Chinese people, especially those in the countryside, still hold various traditional ceremonies. This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that these activities bring us a happy atmosphere, inspire our passion for traditional culture and help us know China's history better. To my understanding, traditional culture can be likened to a bridge, linking the past and today. A case in point is the dragon boat race in the picture. It is this sort of competition that enables teenagers in China to know Qu Yuan and his great patriotism. Accordingly, society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to educate and encourage young people to participate in traditional cultural activities. In the meantime, everyone should bear in mind that our history and culture is the root of the nation. 参考译文： 在一条河中，有一场龙舟比赛，成千上万的村民站在旁边欢呼。与此同时，可以注意到， 一位奶奶和一位爷爷说：“太棒了，我们村的龙舟比赛越来越热闹了。” 中国的突出特征在于其悠久的历史和多样化的文化传统，如端午节、春节和中秋节。为 了保护这些文化遗产，中国人，特别是生活在乡村的人，依然会举行各种传统仪式。这一现 象尤其值得关注，因为这些活动给我们带来快乐的氛围，激发了我们对传统文化的热情，帮 助我们更好地了解中国的历史。在我的理解中，传统文化可以比作一座桥梁，连接过去和今 天。图片中的龙舟比赛就是一个很好的例子。正是这种比赛让中国的青少年知道了屈原及其 伟大的爱国主义精神。 因此，整个社会应营造一种积极的氛围，教育和鼓励年轻人参与传统文化活动。同时， 每个人都应该记住：我们的历史和文化是国家的根基。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写

China is characterized by its time-honored history and diverse cultural traditions, such as the Dragon Boat Festival, the Mid-Autumn Festival and the Spring Festival. To preserve the cultural heritage, Chinese people, especially those in the countryside, still hold various traditional ceremonies. This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that these activities bring us a happy atmosphere, inspire our passion for traditional culture and help us know China's history better. To my understanding, traditional culture can be likened to a bridge, linking the past and today. A case in point is the dragon boat race in the picture. It is this sort of competition that enables teenagers in China to know Qu Yuan and his great patriotism. Accordingly, society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to educate and encourage young people to participate in traditional cultural activities. In the meantime, everyone should bear in mind that our history and culture is the root of the nation.

examples.pageText: 参考范文： This is a column chart, clearly illustrating the striking contrasts in part-time jobs by college students in a certain university. Overall, seniors have the largest proportion of part- time jobs, with 88.24%.Then,the next are juniors and sophomores, at 71.93%and 71.13% respectively. Finally come freshmen, with 67.77%. It is also noticeable that over half of students in four grades take part-time jobs. Such statistics, definitely, can be associated with the popularity of leisure-time jobs among youngsters in college, but what result in this phenomenon? For one thing, college life is characterized by two long vacations-summer and winter vacations, which enable students in college to have adequate spare time to broaden their horizons and gain additional income by doing part-time jobs. For another, compared with students in lower grades, seniors possess richer professional knowledge, greater demand for working experience and less courses. So, a larger percentage of them take part-time positions. 尾段1: University authorities are supposed to provide certain support and guidance for students on how to find and do part-time jobs well. Meanwhile, it is essential for college students to work out comprehensive strategies to balance their academic pursuit and spare-time work. 结尾2: As an adult student, I deem that it is necessary for us to do part-time jobs, which may bring us an opportunity to know the society, arouse our passion for life and helps ease our financial burden. 参考译文： 这是一幅柱状图，清晰展示了某高校大学生在兼职工作方面的显著差异。总体上，大四 学生拥有最高的兼职比例，达到了88.24%；紧随其后的是大三和大二学生，分别是71.93% 和71.13%；排在最后的是大一学生，67.77%。同样明显的是四个年级一半以上的学生有兼 职工作。 上述数据能使人联想到兼职工作在大学生之中的普遍性，但是什么导致了这种现象呢？ 一方面，暑寒暑假这两个长假是大学生活的一个突出特征，这使得大学里的年轻人有足够时 间做兼职工作，进而拓宽视野并获得额外的收入。另一方面，较低年级的学生相比，大四同 学拥有更丰富的专业知识，对工作经验的需求更强烈，同时拥有更多自由时间。因此，他们 之中更大一部分人做兼职。 （结尾1）大学的管理者应在如何找兼职工作和如何做好兼职工作方面给学生提供支持 和指导。同时，大学生也应制定出综合策略来平衡自身的学业和兼职。 （结尾2）作为一个成年学生，我认为，我们有必要做兼职，这将带给我们了解社会的 契机，唤起我们对生活的热爱，有助于减轻我们的经济负担。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题
examples.en: This is a column chart, clearly illustrating the striking contrasts in part-time jobs by college students in a certain university. Overall, seniors have the largest proportion of part- time jobs, with 88. Then,the next are juniors and sophomores, at 71. It is also noticeable that over half of students in four grades take part-time jobs. Such statistics, definitely, can be associated with the popularity of leisure-time jobs among youngsters in college, but what result in this phenomenon? For one thing, college life is characterized by two long vacations-summer and winter vacations, which enable students in college to have adequate spare time to broaden their horizons and gain additional income by doing part-time jobs. For another, compared with students in lower grades, seniors possess richer professional knowledge, greater demand for working experience and less courses. So, a larger percentage of them take part-time positions. University authorities are supposed to provide certain support and guidance for students on how to find and do part-time jobs well. Meanwhile, it is essential for college students to work out comprehensive strategies to balance their academic pursuit and spare-time work. examples.pageText: 作为一个年轻人，我更偏爱乡下的生活，它会带给我新鲜的空气，激发我对自然美景的热爱， 帮助我享受平静的生活。 As a youngster, I prefer the life in the countryside, which can bring/give fresh air, inspire my passion for the natural beauty and help me enjoy the peaceful life. 尾段2： 因此，各级政府应当制定全面战略，缩小城乡差距。同时，更应着力解决城市人口膨胀引发的 各类问题，如交通拥堵、环境污染、房价上涨等。小谭 Accordingly, governments at all levels are supposed to work out comprehensive strategies to shorten the gap between rural and urban areas. Meanwhile, it is advisable for them to focus more on various problems caused by population expansion in cities, such as explosion traffic congestion, environmental pollution, and the increase/rise of housing price. 参考范文： Given is a column chart that clearly illustrates the striking contrasts in populations between urban and rural areas of China from 1990 to 2010.During these two decades, the rural population descended dramatically, from its peak at approximately 820 million to 660 million. By contrast, the number of urban residents showed a sharp rise, from 300million to a little more than 660 million. Such statistics can be associated with the rapid urbanization of China, but what resulted in these differences? To my understanding, at least two fundamental causes can ac-count for this phenomenon. For one thing, in recent years, China was best characterized by its economic boom and its policy in controlling population, which enabled more families in the countryside to have only one kid and some rich families move to cities. For an-other, compared with rural areas, cities enjoy superior educational resources, medical care, employment and other public services. Therefore, cities attract more people to re-side, especially college graduates. Of course, the authorities are supposed to focus more eyesight on the problems caused by population expansion in cities. Meanwhile, it is essential to workout comprehensive strategies to shorten the gap between urban and rural areas.（公众号：学长小谭考研） 参考译文： 所给是一个柱状图，清晰展示了1990 年至2010 年间中国城乡人口的显著差异。 在这二十年中，乡村人口平稳下降，从高峰值约8.2 亿降至6.6 亿。相比而言，城市居 民数量表现出较为明显的增长，从3 亿增长至略高于6.6 亿. 这种情景自然而然能自然联系到中国快速的城镇化，但是什么导致了这些差异？在我看 来，至少两个原因可以解释这种现象。一方面，近些年，中国的突出特征在于其经济的飞速 发展和人口控制政策，这使得更多农村家庭只有一个孩子而且一些富裕家庭搬往城市。另一 方面，与乡村相比，城镇享有更优越的教育资源、医疗服务、就业和其他公共服务。因此， 城市吸引了更多人定居，尤其是大学毕业生。（整理自：学长小谭） 当然，政府应该更多关注城市人口膨胀带来的诸多问题。同时，有必要制定综合策略去 缩小城乡差距。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: 激发我对知识的热情，帮助我拓宽自己的视野。（整理自：学长小谭） As a youngster, I am fond of visiting museums in the spare time, which can bring/give me opportunities to know more history, cultures and customs, inspire my passion for knowledge, and help me broaden my horizons. 尾段2： 作为一名经常访问博物馆的年轻人，我认为，政府应该继续支持博物免费进入的政策。此外， 博物馆管理者应该制定综合性策略来提升服务。 As a youngster who frequently visits museums, I deem that it is advisable for the government to continually support the policy of free admission to museums. In addition, museum administrators are supposed to work out comprehensive strategies to enhance their service. 参考范文： This is a line graph that clearly illustrates the changes in the number of museums and museum visitors in China from 2013 to 2015. During this period, the number of museums ascended remarkably, from 4165 to 4692. Meanwhile, the number of visitors showed a similar trend, from 637. 8 million to 781. 1 million. Such statistics can be associated with the great popularity of museums among the public. For one thing, China was characterized by its economic boom and prosperity in recent years, which enabled the government to possess additional funds to construct more museums for residents. For another, compared with the past, more museums become free of charge to the public, with the authorities’ financial support. Thus, the number of visitors naturally displayed the trend of rise. Indeed, museums inspire visitors, enthusiasm for study and help them acquire the knowledge of the history, customs and cultures. I, as a college student, am convinced that it is of great necessity for the government to support the policy of free admission. Then, museum administrators are supposed to work out comprehensive strategies to enhance their services. （公众号：学长小谭考研） 参考译文： 这是一个线状图，清晰展示了 2013 年至2015 年期间中国博物馆数量和博物馆访客数 量的变化。在此期间，博物馆数量上涨显著，从4165 家增长到了4692 家。同期, 访客数量 呈现出类似趋势，从6. 378 亿增长到7. 811 亿。 小谭上述数据能联系到博物馆在公众之中受到了普遍欢迎。一方面，近年来，经济的蓬勃繁 荣是中国的一大特征，这使得政府有了额外的资金为居民修建更多博物馆。另一方面，与过 去相比，在政府的财政支持下，更多博物馆免费对公众开放。因此，访客数量自然呈现上升 趋势。确实，博物馆唤起参观者的对学习的热情，帮助他们学到历史、习俗和文化知识。 作为一名大学生，我认为，政府很有必要继续支持免费开放政策。同时，博物馆管理者 应该制定综合策略来提升服务。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

Overall, the aim of learning ranks the first, accounting for 58%. Then, the next is searching for information, with 28%, followed by entertainment, at 12%. These statistics above can be associated with the importance of mobile phones in students’ learning and daily life, but what result in the differences? On the one hand, smart phones are characterized by the diverse and powerful functions, which brings them great convenience and enhance their learning efficiency. A typical example is that they, with cell phones, can take online courses and look for useful information anywhere. On the other hand, compared with others, university students suffer greater mental stress, so they relax by listening to music or watching videos on phones. As a youngster, I believe that we should use mobile phones in a rational way. Meanwhile, it is not advisable for anyone to be addicted to online games or social networks. 参考译文： 所给是一幅饼图，清晰地展示了某高校学生手机阅读使用目的对比。总的来看，学习的 目的占最大比例，达到了58%。其次是查资料，占28%，紧随其后是娱乐，占比12%。 以上数据使人想到手机在学生的学习和日常生活中的重要性，但是，是什么导致了这些 差异?一方面，智能手机有多样和强大的功能，给他们带来了极大的方便并提高了他们的学 习效率。一个典型的例子是，他们可以使用手机在任何地方上在线课程、查询有用的信息。 另一方面，与其他人相比，大学生承受着更大的精神压力，所以他们通过用手机听音乐或看 视频来放松。 作为一个年轻人，我认为我们应该合理使用手机。同时，任何人都不应该沉迷于在线游 戏或社交网络。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

(15 points) 课堂练笔： 首段： ①所给是一个柱状图，清晰地展示某城市居民在体育锻炼方式方面显著的差异。 Given/This/It/There is a column chart, clearly illustrating/showing/displaying/presenting the striking contrasts in citizens’/people’s/residents’ ways/means of physical exercise/workout/fitness/ doing sports in a certain university. ②具体来讲，独自锻炼排在第一位，占比54.3%，紧随其后的是与朋友一起运动，占比47.7%。 To be specific/Overall, exercising alone/by themselves ranks the first, accounting for 54.3% followed by working out with friends, with/constituting 47.7%. ③然后是与家人一起锻炼，占23.9%。最后出现的是参加团队活动，占15.8%。 Then, the next is working out with family members, at 23.9%. Finally comes participating in/taking part in/join group/team activities with 15.8%. 二段： ①上述数据，显然，能被联系到体育锻炼在公民中受到的日益欢迎。那么，是什么导致了上述 差异? Such statistics/figures/data, apparently/evidently/clearly/obviously/definitely, can be associated with the increasing popularity of physical exercise among citizens. Then, what results in the differences above? ②一方面，在当今社会，很多人们生活的突出特征就在于较大的精神压力和紧张日程安排/节 奏，这使得他们之中绝大部分人选择独自锻炼。 For one thing, in contemporary society, a host of people's life is characterized by the greater/heavier mental stress, busy schedule and fast pace, which enable a majority of them to choose exercising alone. ③另一方面，与其他方式相比，与朋友一起锻炼能带给他们更强的动力，激发他们运动的热 情，帮助他们提升友谊。 For another, compared with other ways, working out with friends can bring them greater motivation, inspire their passion for sports, and help them consolidate/improve or strengthen friendship. 尾段： ①作为一名正在准备研究生入学考试的年轻人，我非常忙碌，但我依然喜欢每天慢跑半小时。

examples.pageText: As a youngster who is preparing for the national entrance examination for postgraduate studies, am exceedingly busy but I still prefer jogging/swimming/running/playing basketball for half an hour every day. ②正是锻炼使得我保持了身体健康、精力充沛和学习高效。 It is exercise that enables me to stay/maintain=keep healthy physically, energetic, and efficient in learning. 参考范文： Given is a bar chart, clearly illustrating striking contrasts in the ways of citizens physical exercise in a certain city. Overall, exercising alone is the largest proportion, which accounts for 54. 3%. The next is working out with friends, with 47. 7%. Finally come doing exercise with family members and participating in team activities, at 23. 9%and 15. 8% respectively. Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the prevalence of various ways of exercising among citizens. For one thing, living in cities, most residents are characterized by their great pressure in work and busy schedule in daily life, which enable exercising alone to be the priority. For another, compared with other manners, working out with friends can bring them greater motivation, arouse their passion for sports and help them strengthen their friendship. I, as a college student, deem that it is of great necessity for youngsters to do sports every day. It is doing sports that helps us to maintain physical and mental health. 参考译文： 所给的是一个柱状图，清晰展示了某城市市民锻炼方式方面的显著差别。整体看，独自 锻炼的是最大的比重，占到了54.3%。排在第二位的是与朋友一起锻炼，占47.7%。最后是 与家人一起锻炼和参加集体活动，分别占23.9%和15.8%。 显然，上述数据能联系到多种锻炼方式在市民中受到的普遍欢迎。一方面，生活在城市 中，多数居民的突出特征在于他们工作压力大、日常生活时间紧凑，这使得独自锻炼成为他 们的首选。另一方面，与其他方式相比，与朋友一起锻炼可以带给他们更强的动力，唤起他 们对运动的热情，帮助他们提升友谊。 作为一名大学生，我认为年轻人很有必要每天运动。正是运动帮助我们保持身体和心理 的健康。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

(15 points) 课堂练笔： 首段： ①所给的是一个柱状图，清晰展示了2018 到2020 年我国快递业务量的显著变化。 Given/This/It/There is a column chart, clearly illustrating/showing/displaying/presenting the striking changes/contrasts in striking changes in the express volume of/in China from 2018 to 2020. ②具体来讲，总量明显上涨，从510 亿增至80 亿。 o be specific, the total volume ascended/surge/increased/climbed/went up/rose sharply/ obviously/evidently, from 51 billion yuan to 83 billion yuan. ③与此同时，农村地区的业务量表现出明显增长，从120 亿增至300 亿。 Meanwhile, the volume in rural areas showed a remarkable growth, from 12 billion to 30 billion. 二段： ①上述数据，显然，能被联系到快递服务在中国人之中的日益普遍流行和重要性，那么，是什 么导致了这些变化？ Such statistics/figures/data apparently/definitely/clearly/obviously/evidently, can be associated with/linked/related/connected to the increasing/growing significance and popularity of courier service among Chinese Then, what resulted in these changes? ②一方面，近些年来，中国的突出特征就在于经济和互联网的蓬勃繁荣，这使得公民，包括农 村的老百姓，有了额外的收入去享受网络购物。 For one thing, in recent years, China has been characterized by the boom and prosperity in economy and the Internet, which (have) enabled citizens, including residents/folks=people in the countryside/rural residents, to possess/ have/own/gain additional incomes to enjoy online shopping. ③另一方面，去其他方式相比，网购更方便，便宜提供更好的服务。 For another, compared with other means/ways/choices, online shopping is more convenient/easier, cheaper and it can provide better service. ④因此，越来越多的商品和包裹被邮寄给顾客。 Thus, a growing number of/an increasing number of goods/products/items and parcels/commodities/packages were delivered/sent to consumers/buyers/customers. 尾段： ①作为一名正在准备考研的年轻人，我极其忙碌于自己的学术追求。 As a youngster who is preparing for the national entrance examination for postgraduate studies, I am exceedingly busy with my academic/learning/study pursuit.

examples.pageText: ②因此，我更喜欢从网上购买图书、衣服、鞋子、化妆品等，而且我认为快递帮我节约了很多 时间。 Therefore, I prefer purchasing books, clothes shoes and cosmetics from the Internet. I deem that the express service helps me save a lot of time. 参考范文： This is a column chart, which clearly illustrates the striking changes in business volume of express delivery in China from 2018 to 2020. The total volume ascended remarkably, from 51 billion yuan in 2018 to 83 billion yuan in 2020. Meanwhile, the volume in rural areas showed a sharp increase, from 12 billion yuan to 30 billion yuan. Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the growing popularity of courier service in China. There are two reasons accounting for this phenomenon. For one thing, China, in recent years, was characterized by the boom and prosperity in economy, which enabled residents, including people in the countryside, to possess additional money to shop. For another, compared with the past years, more customers chose shopping online and thus, an increasing number of items and parcels were delivered to buyers. As a senior who is preparing for the national entrance examination for postgraduate studies, I am busy with my academic pursuit and so I purchase books, clothes, shoes and cosmetics from the Internet. (15 points) 课堂练笔： 首段： ①所给的是一个线状图，清晰展示了2012 到2020 年期间为中国居民健康素养水平的显著变 化。 Given/This/It/There is a line/curve chart, clearly illustrating/showing/displaying/presenting the striking changes/contrasts in the health literacy level citizens/Chinese/people/residents in China from 2012 to 2021. ②具体来讲，在最初的五年中，该比例缓慢上涨，从8.8%增至11.58%。 To be specific, during the first half-decade/five years, the percentage/proportion ascended/rose/increased/climbed/went up/grew slowly/slightly/steadily, from 8.8% to 11.58%. ③然后，在健康素养水平，有一个显著的上升，从14.18%增至2021 年的最高值25.4%。 Then/After that, there was a sharp/remarkable growth, from 14.18 to the peak of 25.40% in 2021. 二段： ①显然，这些数据能被联系到中国人日益增强的健康意识，那么，是什么导致这种现象? examples.pageText: A case in point is that a host of people know how to stay healthy by watching TV programs or videos. 尾段： ①作为一名正在准备考研的年轻人，我很重视健康。 As a youngster/senior who is preparing for the national entrance examination for postgraduate studies, I attach great importance to my health. ②因此，我经常锻炼，这带给我充沛的精力，激发了我对生活的热爱，并帮助我保持了学习的 高效。 Accordingly/Thus=So=Therefore, I do sports regularly, which can give/bring me full energy, inspire my passion for life, and help me keep efficient in learning. 参考范文： Given is a line chart, clearly illustrating the striking changes in the health literacy level of Chinese citizens from 2012 to 2021.During the first half-decade, the proportion ascended slowly, from 8.80%to 11.58%. Then, there was a sharp increase, from 14.18%tothe peak at 25.40%in 2021. Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the growing health awareness of Chinese people, but what resulted in this phenomenon? For one thing, in recent years, China was characterized by the boom and prosperity in economy, which enabled an increasing number of Chinese to enjoy a better life and medical service. For another, compared with the past years, Chinese people have more accesses to knowledge concerning health literacy. A case in point is that many people now learn how to keep healthy by watching short videos or TV programs. As a youngster who is preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, I pay much attention to my health and I do sports regularly, which can bring me full energy, inspire my passion for life and help me stay efficient in learning. 参考译文： 所给的是一张折线图，清楚地说明了2012 年至2021 中国公民健康素养水平的显著变 化。在前五年中，这一比例缓慢上升，从8.80%升到11.58%。然后，这一比率迅速上升，从 14.18%上升到2021 的峰值25.40%。 显然，这些统计数字与中国人日益增长的健康意识有关，那么，是什么导致了这一现象？ 一方面，近年来，中国经济繁荣，使越来越多的中国人享受到更好的生活和医疗服务。另一 方面，与过去几年相比，中国人有更多机会获得有关健康素养的知识。一个很好的例子是， 许多人是通过观看短视频、图片或电视节目知道了如何保持健康。 作为一名准备参加考研的年轻人，我非常关注自己的健康，而且我经常做运动，这给我 带来充沛的精力，激发我对生活的热情，帮助我保持了学习的效率。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: 尾段： 作为一个年轻人，我喜欢上类似的课，因为正是这些课程使得有机会将理论付诸实践。因此， 大学生应该设置更多实践劳动课程。同时，他们还应该制定综合性策略来确保课程质量。 As a youngster, I prefer attending courses like this since/as/because it is these courses that enable us to have opportunities to put theory into practice. Thus, it is advisable for universities to set more labor practice courses. Meanwhile, they are supposed to work out comprehensive strategies to ensure the quality of courses. 参考范文： This is a column chart, which clearly illustrates the striking contrasts in main gains of students' labor practice courses in a certain university. Overall, acquiring relevant knowledge ranks the first, accounting for 91. 30%, followed by the improvement of labor ability, with 84. 80%. Then, the next is feeling comfortable, at 54. 40%. Finally comes the enhancement of the ability to cooperate, at 32. 60%. Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the significance of labor practice for youngsters, but what result in the phenomenon above? For one thing, college students are characterized by their strong desire to enhance themselves, which enables knowledge and competence to be the main target for them. For another, compared with other courses, labor practice courses are more interesting, which can bring students a good mood, arouse their passion for labor, and help them enhance the team spirit. As a youngster, I prefer attending courses like this since it is these courses that enable me to have opportunities to put theory into practice. Thus, it is advisable for universities to set more labor practice courses. Meanwhile, they are also supposed to work out comprehensive strategies to ensure the quality of courses. 参考译文： 这是一个柱状图，清晰展示了某高校学生在劳动实践课程主要收获方面的显著对比。总 体而言，掌握相关知识排在第一位，占91.30%，其次是劳动能力的提高，占84.80%。其次 是感觉舒适，占54.40%。最后是合作能力的提升，占32.60%。 显然，上述数据能被联系到劳动实践对年轻人的重要性，但是什么导致了上述现象？一 方面，大学生的特点在于他们自我提升的强烈欲望，这使得知识和能力成为他们的主要目标。 另一方面，与其他课程相比，劳动实践课程更有趣，可以给他们带来良好的情绪，激发他们 对劳动的热情，帮助他们增强团队精神 作为一个年轻人，我更喜欢参加这类课程因为正是这些课程使我有机会将理论付诸实 践。因此，高校应该开设更多的劳动实践课程。同时，他们也应该制定全面的策略来确保课 程质量。 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: Directions n.指令 newly arrived 刚到达的 recommending v.推荐 tourist attractions 旅游景点 • 题目解析 o 命题形式：电子邮件写作（推荐信类型） o 审题要点： ▪ 收件人：新到任的澳大利亚教授James Cook ▪ 核心要求：推荐所在城市的多个旅游景点（注意“some”表示复数要求） ▪ 格式要求：使用“李明”代替真名，不写地址 o 内容构建： ▪ 推荐北京历史景点（颐和园、故宫、长城等） ▪ 推荐理由框架：了解历史、激发文化热爱、欣赏自然风光 o 易错点：仅推荐单个景点违反“some”的复数要求（公众号：学长小谭考研） 例2：2017 年英语(二) Directions: Suppose you are invited by Professor Williams to give a presentation about Chinese culture to a group of international students. Write a reply to 1)accept the invitation, and 2)introduce the key points of your presentation You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. examples.pageText: 例3：2016 年英语(一) Directions: Suppose you are a librarian in your university. Write a notice of about 100 words, providing the newly-enrolled international students with relevant information about the library. You should write neatly on the ANWSER SHEET. Do not sign you own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) librarian n.图书管理员 notice n.通知 newly-enrolled 刚录取；刚注册 relevant adj.相关的 • 题目解析 o 命题变体：图书管理员写通知给国际新生 o 关键词解析： ▪ “newly enrolled”对应前文“newly arrived”（命题词汇重复规律） ▪ 图书馆特征描述：藏书丰富→阅读价值→知识获取 o 格式差异：通知与书信格式不同但内容可相似 o 功能句应用： ▪ 场所特征→具体资源→使用建议（带学生卡） ▪ 复用景点推荐框架：特征→具体内容→价值 o 时间管理：熟练功能句可节省写作时间用于其他题型 小作文体裁总结 高频考查类型 书信：Letter/Email 最基础且常见的考查形式 通知：Notice/Announcement 包括书面通知和口头通知，考查频率较高 低频考查类型 海报：Poster 因涉及美术设计，考试不考查美术功底，故可能性低 简历：Resume 本质是自我介绍，与部分考查内容有重叠 假条：A Request for Leave 因字数限制（通常只需简短说明），考查可能性小 新增考查类型 会议纪要（minutes）：最新大 纲新增，但可用功能句应对 注意：minutes 与“分钟”同形异义，此处表示“纪要”

Write a letter to the department concerned, asking them to help find a candidate. You should specify what kind of child you want to help and how you will carry out your plan. You should write neatly on the ANWSER SHEET. Do not sign you own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) contribute to 为...做贡献 offering v.提供 financial aid 财政帮助 remote adj.偏远的 department concerned 相关部门 candidate n.候选人 specify v.详细说明 carry out 开展 • 对希望工程的理解 • 提出观点：每个人都应该为希望工程做贡献 o 贡献理解: ▪ 不一定是金钱捐赠 ▪ 宣传希望工程也是贡献 ▪ 反对“道德绑架”的说法 • 详细描述想要帮助的孩子类型详细描述想要帮助的孩子类型 o 基本描述: ▪ 来自偏远地区（remote area），使用from 或in 都可以 o 贫困程度描述: ▪ “whose family is so impoverished that...” ▪ impoverished: 非常贫穷（如冬天穿露腚裤子）so...that 结构表示程度 o 具体困境: ▪ cannot afford tuition • 提出观点：每个人都应该为希望工程做贡献 o 三个关键特征: ▪ 来自偏远地区 ▪ 家庭贫困 ▪ 交不起学费 o 写作要求: ▪ 需要详细说明帮助对象的具体情况 ▪ 说明帮助计划如何实施 o 注意事项: ▪ 不需要过度具体化（如精确到村名） ▪ 保持合理范围内的描述

To begin with, compared with students’ demands in learning, the variety/kind/ category/type and number of books here are not adequate inadequate. Thus, it is advisable to purchase more latest adj.最新的 books. examples.pageText: 参考范文： Notice Friday, June 10th This notice is for the purpose of recruiting 25 volunteers for the international conference on globalization, which is scheduled to be held in our university. This conference will start on June 20th and last (for) three days. Since a majority of its participants are foreigners, it is appropriate for applicants to be able to speak at least one foreign language, such as English, French or Spanish, which will help volunteers communicate with foreign experts or scholars smoothly. In addition to this qualification, applicants are supposed to be warmhearted and considerate and it is your service that will enable foreign guests to enjoy a comfortable trip in China. There will be an interview for applicants in the Office of Postgraduates’ Association at 14:00 on June 16. Your excellent teaching, which brings us abundant/rich knowledge, arouses/inspires our passion for learning, and helps us enhance/improve our English speech ability/proficiency. Do not use your name in the notice. • 题目解析：该项目旨在帮助偏远农村小学的贫困家庭儿童获得更好的教育机会 o 背景分析：学生会指派通知留学生歌唱比赛事宜 o 内容要点：需明确通知对象、事件性质（参赛/观赛） • 写作框架: o 寒暄句（如"很高兴通知..."） o 通知目的（介绍活动安排） o 具体细节（时间、地点等） 参考范文： Notice June 20 We are quite/very/much/pretty/particularly/exceedingly/extraordinarily pleased/ happy/glad/excited to inform you that a singing contest held by the Student Union, and this notice is for the purpose of introducing relevant arrangements and details. To begin with/ First=First of all=Above all, this contest is scheduled/planned/arranged/going to start at 14:00 on September 20 in the Center of Student's Activities and last for approximately=about =roughly 2 hours. In addition, provided that you are contestants as individuals or groups/teams. Of course, you are supposed to prepare your own musical and accompaniment/music/BGM. Finally, you are welcome to watch the contest as audience. 尾段1 ：We deem that with your support and participation, this contes will be successful and fabulous/fantastic/wonderful. 尾段2：Please feel free to inform us, if you have any suggestion or requirement. The Student Union 参考译文： 通知 6 月20 日 很高兴通知大家一个歌唱比赛即将由学生会来主办，本通知的目的就是介绍安排/细节。 首先，本次比赛计划于9 月20 日14:00 在学生活动中心开始，并持续约2 小时。此外， 如果你是以个人或团体的参赛选手，你应该到学生报名并在比赛前一天在活动中心进行彩 排。当然，你还应该准备自己的乐器和伴奏。最后，欢迎大家以观众身份来看比赛。 尾段1：我们相信，在大家的支持和参与下，本次比赛将会是圆满成功的。
examples.en: Directions: The Student Union of your university has assigned you to inform the international students of an upcoming singing contest. Student Union, and this notice is for the purpose of introducing relevant arrangements and details. Finally, you are welcome to watch the contest as audience. Please feel free to inform us, if you have any suggestion or requirement.

examples.pageText: 21 年英一：建议+说明 Directions: One foreign friend of yours has recently graduated from college and intends to find a job in China. Please write an email to him/her to make some suggestions. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in the email. Use “Li Ming" instead. (10 points) • 背景分析：题目给出“外国朋友刚大学毕业，打算在中国找工作”的写作背景 • 体裁确认：要求写一封电子邮件（email），属于非正式文体 • 内容要求：需要给出求职建议，字数限制100 词左右 • 建议内容： o 城市选择：推荐北京，因其"广泛的就业机会(extensive job opportunities)"和"高薪待遇(high salaries)" o 职位推荐： ▪ 英语教师：适合英语专业或有教学经验者 ▪ 杂志编辑：适合编辑相关专业背景者 o 优势论证： ▪ 母语优势：native English speaker ▪ 经验优势：worked as part-time teacher in training organizations ▪ 专业对口：major in English Education/Journalism 参考范文： Dear Sky, So pleased to hear that you have graduated from Peking University and intend to hunt for a job in China. Today, I'm writing to make several/some=certain=a few certain suggestions. To begin with/First of all=Above all=First, I deem/reckon/believe/hold/suppose that it is advisable for you to look for a job in Beijing since/as/because Beijing, as the capital, is characterized/marked by abundant/many/a host of/a sea of/a large number of job/employment opportunities and high salaries/incomes. In addition/Additionally/Besides/Furthermore/What is more, you are supposed/well-advised to apply for the position of English teacher at/in some training organization/institution since compared with others, you, as a native English speaker have/posses/own/enjoy a host of advantages. A case in point is that you're a native English speaker and you have worked as a part-time English teacher in famous renowned/well-known/prestigious training institutions. In a nutshell, I am convinced that you will be a qualified and excellent English teacher. The Student Union 参考译文： 亲爱的思凯： 很高兴听说你已经从北大毕业并打算在中国找份工作。今天我写信目的是提点建议。 首先，我认为，你应在北京找工作，因为其突出特征就在于广泛的就业机会和高薪。此 外，你应该申请培训机构英语教师的岗位，因为与他人相比，你有诸多优势。一个典型例子 就是，你是英语是母语的人，而且曾经在若干知名培训机构当过兼职英语老师。

examples.pageText: 22 年英一：邀请+说明 Directions: Write an email to a professor at a British university inviting him/her to organize a team for the international innovation contest to be held at your university. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in the email. Use “Li Ming" instead. (10 points) 参考范文： Dear Professor Sky, As the chairman of the organizing committee of the international innovation contest, I am writing for the purpose of inviting you to organize a team for the contest. To begin with(First=First of all=Above all), this contest/competition is scheduled(planned /going/arranged) to start on December 1st in the Center of Students' Activities(the Lecture Hall) at/of Peking University and last (for) approximately(=about) 3 days. In addition/Furthermore=Besides=Additionally=What is more=Moreover, compared with others, you possess=have=own=boast richer/more experience in innovative ad 创新的 theoretical research and developing/designing/making/creating products and theoretical. Thus, we sincerely hope/expect that you can lead your team and participate in/take part in this contest. We are convinced that /We deem that your participation will bring everyone new horizons/thoughts/ideas, inspire youngsters' passion/enthusiasm for innovation, and help the contest be successful. 尾段1：Finally, we are looking forward to your favorable reply at your earliest convenience. 尾段2：Finally, if you have any other questions, suggestions/advice or demands/requirements please feel free to inform us. 尾段3：Finally, we will be quite grateful if you are so kind to participate in the contest. The Student Union 参考译文： 亲爱的思凯教授： 作为国际创新比赛组委会主席，我写信目的是邀请您组队参赛。今天，我写信想要提几 个建议。 首先，本次比赛计划于12 月1 日在北京大学学生活动中心开始，并持续约3 天。此外， 与其他人相比，您在创新理论研究和产品研发和理论研究方面具有更加丰富的经验。因此， 我们诚挚地希望您能组队参赛。我们相信您的参与将会带来新的视野，激发年轻人对创新的 热情，并助力本次比赛成功。 尾段1 最后，我们期待着您在方便时尽快给我们回复。 尾段2 最后，如果您有其他任何问题、建议或要求，请不要不好意思告知我们。 尾段3 最后，我们将会非常感谢，如果您是如此善良愿意来参赛。 谨上

To begin with/First of all=Above all=Firstly, it is advisable for you to purchase/buy=subscribe a book about/on/concerning China’s ancient scientists and choose/select one (who/whom) you are interested in. Then, you are supposed to search/look for a few/some=certain=a number of this scientist’s pictures and major/main achievements/stories on the Internet, which can give you ideas/inspiration/enlightenment, inspire/evoke your passion for exploring/learning, and help you make the report successfully. (10 points) librarian n.图书管理员 notice n.通知 newly-enrolled 刚录取；刚注册 relevant adj.相关的 • 题目解析 o 命题变体：图书管理员写通知给国际新生 o 关键词解析： ▪ “newly enrolled”对应前文“newly arrived”（命题词汇重复规律） ▪ 图书馆特征描述：藏书丰富→阅读价值→知识获取 o 格式差异：通知与书信格式不同但内容可相似 o 功能句应用： ▪ 场所特征→具体资源→使用建议（带学生卡） ▪ 复用景点推荐框架：特征→具体内容→价值 o 时间管理：熟练功能句可节省写作时间用于其他题型 小作文体裁总结 高频考查类型 书信：Letter/Email 最基础且常见的考查形式 通知：Notice/Announcement 包括书面通知和口头通知，考查频率较高 低频考查类型 海报：Poster 因涉及美术设计，考试不考查美术功底，故可能性低 简历：Resume 本质是自我介绍，与部分考查内容有重叠 假条：A Request for Leave 因字数限制（通常只需简短说明），考查可能性小 新增考查类型 会议纪要（minutes）：最新大 纲新增，但可用功能句应对 注意：minutes 与“分钟”同形异义，此处表示“纪要”

examples.pageText: 2.2 应用文真题精讲、实训及模拟预测 精讲1：辞职+道歉（05 年英一） Directions: 背景：打散＋改写【Two months ago, you got a job as an editor for the magazine Design & Fashion. But now you find that the work is not what you expected. You decided to quit. 】Write a letter to your boss, Mr. Wang, telling him your decision, stating your reasons, and making apologies. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Don't use your own name, use “Li Ming” instead. (10 points) editor n.编辑 magazine n.杂志 Design & Fashion 设计与时尚 quit v.退出；辞职 stating v.说明 apologies n.道歉 • 审题要点 o 背景信息识别：前三句话为写作背景，可标注“背景”二字。 o 题材确认：“Write a letter”明确写作题材为书信，且给老板写信需采用正式语气 o 内容要求：必须包含三个要素：告知辞职决定、说明理由、表达歉意 • 写作技巧 o 背景处理原则：采用“打散加改写”方法，不可直接照抄原文 o 评分重点：小作文重在说清事情，不需追求复杂词汇和高端句式，满足内容要求且语言无误即 可得8-9 分小谭 o 格式注意事项：考试结尾提示语必须阅读，防止出现署名要求变更等细节调整（如“李明”可 能改为“李刚”） 参考范文： Dear Mr. Wang, I am very pleased to recall the past two months when 定从 I worked as an editor for your magazine. However, I am writing for the purpose of quitting, since this work is not what I expected. 强调句式:It was your (help) and other colleagues’ tremendous help that enabled me to accumulate certain ability and experience. Thus, I am quite grateful to you for your help. Anyway, my competence, compared with the 称谓：顶格写，后面用逗号 正文段首句缩进四个字符/字母 very 同义替换：quite/exceedingly/particularly/ fairly/pretty/extremely/really/so/much adv.非常 pleased adj.高兴的= happy/excited/glad/delighted recall v.回想起 for the purpose of 为了…目的 since because/as quitting 同义替换：resigning colleagues n.同事 tremendous adj.巨大的 enabled v.使得...能

Anyway adv.然而 competence n.能力 compared with 与...相比 demands n.要求 落款：中间靠右即可 adequate adj.足够的 =ample/sufficient/enough In addition 此外 =Besides/Additionally/What is more/Furthermore/Moreover keen on 喜爱=interested in =fond of rather than 而不是 To conclude 总之 = In a word/All in all/In conclusion /To sum up/In short deem v.认为 = think/hold/suppose/reckon... advisable adj.明智的 sensible/rational stand in my shoes 替我着想 参考译文： 尊敬的王先生： 很高兴回想起过去的这两个月，期间我在贵杂志当编辑。但我写信的目的是辞职，因为 这份工作并非我所期待的。 正是您和其他同事的巨大帮助使得我积累了一定的经验和能力。因此，我非常感激你们 的帮助。然而，与工作的要求相比，我的能力不足，做不好这份工作。此外，我感兴趣的是 计算机科学而非编辑。总之，继续该工作对于我而言是不明智的。 最后，（公众号：学长小谭考研）我很希望您能站在我的立场思考一下并接受我的道歉。 谨上 李明 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: 实训1：道歉+建议（08 年英一） Directions: You have just come back from Canada and found a music CD in your luggage that you forgot to return to Bob, your landlord there. Write him a letter to 1)make an apology; 2)suggest a solution You should write neatly on the ANWSER SHEET. Do not sign you own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) luggage n.行李 【记忆法：谐音“拉杆儿”联想“行李箱”，表示“行李”】 landlord n.房东（谐音记单词：懒得劳动）【构成：land（土地）+lord（爵士）→土地所有者 →房东/地主】 solution n.解决方法 • 审题要点 o 写作背景识别：题干第一段描述“从加拿大回来发现忘记归还CD 给房东Bob” o 题材确认：明确要求写一封信，标注“写作题材：信” o 核心任务：必须完成两个指令： o 1) make an apology（道歉）；2) suggest a solution（提出解决方案） o 格式要求：100 词左右，署名用“Li Ming”，不写地址 • 写作技巧 o 开篇策略：避免生硬套用模板，应结合背景自然过渡 o 时间表达：可用“the past days/weeks/months/years”灵活调整时间跨度 o 定语从句：用“when”引导时间段，如“when I studied in Canada” o 写作技巧居住表达：优先用“lived in your house”，避免用“room”（暗示侵入感） • 易错提醒 o 标点错误：称谓后用逗号，勿用冒号 o 时态错误：回忆内容必须用过去式（studied/lived） o 拼写错误：writing 易错写为“writing” 丨 forgot 易错用现在式“forget” o 用词不当：避免使用“room”代替“house” 参考中文思路：看汉语思路写英文句子，15 分钟内完成 亲爱的的鲍勃： 我很高兴地回想起过去的这些天，期间我在加拿大学习并住在您的房子里。然而，我写 信目的是道歉，因为我忘记归还您的CD 了。 正是您和您家人的巨大/善意帮助使得我在加拿大享受了一段舒适并富有成果的学习之 旅。因此，我非常感激您们。然而，与您相比，我更粗心，直到回到中国我才在自己的行李 里发现了你的CD。因此，我认为，我应该立即用EMS=Express Mail Service 给你寄送回去。当然， 如果您有其他偏爱的解决办法，请不要不好意思告知我。 再次为引发的不便向您致歉。 谨上 李明

It was your and your family members’ tremendous=kind .adj.巨大的 help that enabled me to enjoy a comfortable and fruitful/fantastic/wonderful/colorful trip of learning in your country. Once again, I am deeply sorry for any inconvenience n.不便 caused. Yours sincerely, Li Ming 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: 精讲2：求助+描述（06 年英一） Directions: You want to contribute to Project Hope by offering financial aid to a child in a remote area. Write a letter to the department concerned, asking them to help find a candidate. You should specify what kind of child you want to help and how you will carry out your plan. You should write neatly on the ANWSER SHEET. Do not sign you own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) contribute to 为...做贡献 offering v.提供 financial aid 财政帮助 remote adj.偏远的 department concerned 相关部门 candidate n.候选人 specify v.详细说明 carry out 开展 • 对希望工程的理解 • 提出观点：每个人都应该为希望工程做贡献 o 贡献理解: ▪ 不一定是金钱捐赠 ▪ 宣传希望工程也是贡献 ▪ 反对“道德绑架”的说法 • 详细描述想要帮助的孩子类型详细描述想要帮助的孩子类型 o 基本描述: ▪ 来自偏远地区（remote area），使用from 或in 都可以 o 贫困程度描述: ▪ “whose family is so impoverished that...” ▪ impoverished: 非常贫穷（如冬天穿露腚裤子）so...that 结构表示程度 o 具体困境: ▪ cannot afford tuition • 提出观点：每个人都应该为希望工程做贡献 o 三个关键特征: ▪ 来自偏远地区 ▪ 家庭贫困 ▪ 交不起学费 o 写作要求: ▪ 需要详细说明帮助对象的具体情况 ▪ 说明帮助计划如何实施 o 注意事项: ▪ 不需要过度具体化（如精确到村名） ▪ 保持合理范围内的描述
