examples.label: 参考范文： Dear Sir or Madam, As a senior at Peking University who pays great attention to Project Hope, I am writing for the…
examples.pageText: 参考范文： Dear Sir or Madam, As a senior at Peking University who pays great attention to Project Hope, I am writing for the purpose of finding a candidate since I intend to offer financial help to him/her. Project Hope is characterized by people’s warm help, which enables a host of poor children to gain the opportunity of education. Accordingly, to my understand- ing, it is advisable for everyone to contribute to Project Hope and I want to help a child from a remote area, whose family is so impoverished that they cannot afford tuition. Compared with others, I am not richer but I am willing to do my utmost to help her/him finish education from high school to college. Finally, I want to say that I am quite grateful for your hard work and I am looking forward to your favorable reply at your earliest convenience. Yours sincerely, Li Ming As prep.作为 senior n.大四学生 since=because offer=give/provide 【首段：自我介绍＋写信目的】 characterized by 突出特征是=featured warm adj.热情的 which 定从 定从两步走： 1.先写一个简单句，找重点名词 2.在该名词后，用which/who/that/when/where 造 句，对名词进行补充说明 a host of=many gain v.得到=get/obtain/have/possess to my understanding =in my opinion/from my perspective advisable adj.明智的 impoverished adj.贫困的 afford v.支付得起tuition n.学费 richer rich 的比较级=wealthier 更富 willing to adj.乐意 do my utmost =try my best grateful adj.感激的 （整理自：学长小谭） 参考译文： 尊敬的先生/女士： 作为北京大学一名非常关注希望工程的大四学生，我写信想要找一个候选人，因为我想 要给他/她提供经济上的帮助。 希望工程的突出特征就在于热心人士的帮助，这使得很多贫困的孩子得到了教育的机 会。因此，在我看来，每个人都应该为希望工程贡献自己的力量，我想帮助一个偏远地区、 家庭贫穷无法支付起学费的孩子。与他人相比，虽然我不算更富有，但还是愿尽自己最大努 力帮助他/她完成从中学到大学的学业。 最后，我想说，非常感谢你们的辛勤工作，我期待着能尽快收到回复。 谨上 李明 英文写作技巧 1）书信写作结构 • 开头称呼：使用"Dear Sir or Madam"表示正式称呼 • 自我介绍：采用"as+身份+定语从句"结构建立联系，如"As a senior at Peking University who..." • 写作目的：使用"I am writing for the purpose of..."明确表达意图
examples.en: Accordingly, to my understand- ing, it is advisable for everyone to contribute to Project Hope and I want to help a child from a remote area, whose family is so impoverished that they cannot afford tuition. Finally, I want to say that I am quite grateful for your hard work and I am looking forward to your favorable reply at your earliest convenience.
examples.zh: 尊敬的先生/女士： 作为北京大学一名非常关注希望工程的大四学生，我写信想要找一个候选人，因为我想 要给他/她提供经济上的帮助。 希望工程的突出特征就在于热心人士的帮助，这使得很多贫困的孩子得到了教育的机 会。因此，在我看来，每个人都应该为希望工程贡献自己的力量，我想帮助一个偏远地区、 家庭贫穷无法支付起学费的孩子。与他人相比，虽然我不算更富有，但还是愿尽自己最大努 力帮助他/她完成从中学到大学的学业。 最后，我想说，非常感谢你们的辛勤工作，我期待着能尽快收到回复。 谨上 李明 英文写作技巧 1）书信写作结构 • 开头称呼：使用"Dear Sir or Madam"表示正式称呼 • 自我介绍：采用"as+身份+定语从句"结构建立联系，如"As a senior at Peking University who..." • 写作目的：使用"I am writing for the purpose of..."明确表达意图

examples.pageText: • 项目特征：描述项目特点时可用"is characterized by"或"featured with"句式 • 结尾致谢：使用"Finally, I want to say that I am quite grateful for..."表达感谢 • 落款格式：正式信件以"Yours sincerely,"结尾 2）经济资助表达 • 资助意愿： o "I am willing to do my utmost to help..." o "try/do my best to..." o "make every effort to..." • 经济状况说明： o "I am not richer/wealthy/well-off/rich enough" o "Compared with others, I am not richer but..." • 教育阶段：明确说明"from high school to college" 3）性别表达规范 • 不确定性别时：建议使用"he or she"或"him/her"的完整形式 • 考试要求：虽然只写一个性别通常不会扣分，但完整形式更规范 • 实际应用：当题干未明确性别时，可选择指定性别或保持中性表达 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: 实训2：描述+建议（07 年英一） Directions: Write a letter to your university library, making suggestions for improving its service. You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2. Do not sign your name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) 1）审题技巧 • 三遍阅读法: 题目需完整阅读三遍，重点关注写作背景信息、题材类型和内容要求三个维度 • 隐含信息提取: 当题干未明确说明背景时，需自行推导合理背景（如“给大学图书馆写信”隐含身份 是该校学生） • 极端情况处理: 若题干假设与实际情况冲突（如大学无图书馆），可直接说明事实后结束写作，不会 影响评分 2）第一句写作 o 身份确认: 通过"your university library"可推导作者身份为该校学生，且该校存在图书馆设施 o 服务对象: 收信方为图书馆管理人员，需保持正式语气，使用"Dear Sir/Madam"开头（注意英文用 逗号而非冒号） • 写作目的与要求 o 核心任务: 提出至少两条改进建议（making suggestions 为复数形式） o 字数规范: 严格控制在100 词左右，使用答题卡2 作答 o 署名要求: 必须使用"Li Ming"代替真名，不得书写地址（但可写学校名称如"Peking University"） • 考场答题时间分配 o 黄金法则: 按1 分=1.8 分钟计算，10 分作文建议用时18 分钟（允许15-20 分钟浮动） o 答题顺序: 保持与平时模考相同的写作顺序（先写/后写作文均可） • 开篇第一句话的编写 o 结构选择: 直接自我介绍而非寒暄（因与收信人无私人关系） o 功能实现: 需建立写信人与收信机构的合理联系 3）第二段写作 （公众号：学长小谭考研） • 建议内容讨论 o 建议的恰当性 ▪ 避免不当建议：不应提出与环境卫生相关的建议（如上厕所不冲水），这类内容会让阅卷老师产 生不良印象 ▪ 建议方向选择：应聚焦于与学习直接相关的服务改进，如图书资源、开放时间等 • 图书种类与数量不足 o 问题表述： ▪ 主体结构：采用"与...相比"的对比句式，完整表达为"与学生在学习方面的需求相比，图书的种 类和数量是不足的" o 建议方案： ▪ 句式："因此应该购买更多最新的图书"

examples.pageText: 参考范文： Dear Sir or Madam, As a senior in of/from our this university who is particularly fond of keen on/fond of reading in this library in spare free/leisure time, I am writing for the purpose of making offering=proposing=giving suggestions for improving enhancing the service here. To begin with, compared with students’ demands in learning, the variety/kind/ category/type and number of books here are not adequate inadequate. Thus, it is advisable to purchase more latest adj.最新的 books. In addition, because a host of seniors, including me, are preparing for the national adj.全国的 entrance examination for postgraduates, you are supposed to prolong the opening hours of reading rooms where they study. 尾段一：Finally, I, on behalf of all students, am quite grateful to you for your hard work and it is your efforts that enable us to enjoy a positive learning atmosphere here. 尾段二：Finally, I deem that with our joint/shared efforts the library service will be improved greatly. Yours sincerely, Li Ming 参考译文： 尊敬的先生/女士： 作为本校一名业余时间喜欢在图书馆看书的大四同学，我写信想要提建议改进图书馆的 服务。 首先，与学生学习的需求相比，图书的种类和数量是不足的。因此，你们应该购买更多 最新的图书。此外，因为包括我在内的很多大四学生正在准备全国研究生入学考试，有必要 延长阅览室的开放时间。 尾段一：最后，我代表所有学生，感谢你们的辛勤工作，正是你们的努力让我们受到了这里良 好的学习氛围。 尾段二：最后，我认为通过我们共同的努力，图书馆的服务将会得到极大的提升。 谨上 李明 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.label: 精讲3：招募+通知（10 年英一） Directions: You are supposed to write for the Postgraduates’ Association a notice to recruit volunteer…
examples.pageText: 精讲3：招募+通知（10 年英一） Directions: You are supposed to write for the Postgraduates’ Association a notice to recruit volunteers for an international conference on globalization. The notice should include the basic qualifications for applicants and other information which you think is relevant. You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2. Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Use “Postgraduates' Association instead. (10 points) the Postgraduates’ Association 研究生协会 notice n.通知 recruit v.招募 volunteers n.志愿者 conference n.会议 globalization n.全球化 globe n.地球; global adj.全球的; globalize v.全球化 qualifications qualify v.使…有资格 • 题目解析： o 背景信息处理：采用"拆分+改写"方法，避免直接照抄题干。例如可写："通知的目的是为某国 际会议招募志愿者"或"我们很高兴得知关于全球化的国际会议将在我校举办" o 关键要素： ▪ 主办方：Postgraduates' Association（研究生会） ▪ 核心内容：recruit volunteers for an international conference on globalization ▪ 要求：包含申请者基本资质(basic qualifications)和其他相关信息 o 资质建议： ▪ 外语能力（因涉及international 和globalization） ▪ 服务精神（热心、周到、有经验等） o 其他信息：可补充会议时间地点、面试安排等 • 格式要点： o 首行居中写"NOTICE" o 可注明发布日期 o 正文分2-3 段 o 落款用"Postgraduates' Association"（不可用个人姓名） • 写作时间建议：考场上建议用18 分钟左右完成小作文 • 特殊提示：对于英语基础薄弱的考生，可通过认真写作争取30-40 分（适合分数线较低的专业） • 通知范文结构： o 开头：明确写作目的（如招募志愿者） o 中间： ▪ 会议基本信息（主题、时间地点等） ▪ 志愿者要求（资质、能力等） ▪ 报名方式 o 结尾：发通知单位（题干指定）

examples.pageText: 参考范文： Notice Friday, June 10th This notice is for the purpose of recruiting 25 volunteers for the international conference on globalization, which is scheduled to be held in our university. This conference will start on June 20th and last (for) three days. Since a majority of its participants are foreigners, it is appropriate for applicants to be able to speak at least one foreign language, such as English, French or Spanish, which will help volunteers communicate with foreign experts or scholars smoothly. In addition to this qualification, applicants are supposed to be warmhearted and considerate and it is your service that will enable foreign guests to enjoy a comfortable trip in China. There will be an interview for applicants in the Office of Postgraduates’ Association at 14:00 on June 16. Postgraduates’ Association 正文中间写：标题 6.10 、10/06 第二行靠右写日期 th 可省 scheduled v.计划 conference =meeting last (for)v.持续 participants n.参与者 foreigners n.外国人 appropriate adj.合理的=advisable experts n.专家 scholars n.学者 smoothly adv.顺利地 In addition to 除...之外 warmhearted adj.热心的 considerate adj.周到的=thoughtful at+具体时刻（几点几分）；on+具体某一 天 落款：中间靠右 参考译文： 通知 6 月10 日星期五 本通知的目的是为将要在我校举办的关于全球化的国际会议招募25 名志愿者。 这次会议将于6 月20 日开始并持续三天。因为多数参会者是外国人，志愿者的申请者 应该能讲至少一门外语，比如，英语、法语或西班牙语。这将有助于志愿者 与外国专家或 学者沟通顺畅。除了这个条件外，申请者应该热情细致，而且正是你们的服务将会使得外国 客人享受到一段舒适的中国之旅。 6 月16 日14:00 在研究生会办公室将会有一个针对申请人的面试。 研究生协会 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

In addition to this qualification, applicants are supposed to be warmhearted and considerate and it is your service that will enable foreign guests to enjoy a comfortable trip in China.

examples.pageText: 实训3：通知+介绍（15 年英二） Directions: Suppose your university is going to host a summer camp for high school students. Write a notice 1) briefly introduce the camp activities, and 2) call for volunteers You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your name or the name of your university. Do not write your address. (10 points) • 审题要点： o 背景信息改写：题干中"host a summer camp"可改写为被动语态"will be hosted by our university"，避免直接照抄 o 功能句组合：提前准备汉语思路和对应英文表达，考场直接组合使用 • 活动设计： o 学术讲座：可包含教授/外籍专家讲座 o 校园参观：志愿者带领高中生熟悉校园环境 o 避免内容：谈情说爱、荒野求生等不恰当活动 • 志愿者要求： o 组织能力：需具备活动组织经验 o 校园熟悉度：了解学校历史和布局 o 语言能力：建议掌握至少一门外语（针对外籍参与者） • 通知格式： o 首行：居中写"NOTICE" o 日期：虚构合理日期（如June 10, Friday） o 段落：段落间不空行，采用缩进式 • 开头句式： o 高兴表达：可用"We are very pleased/delighted/excited to hear that..." o 被动改写："a summer camp for high school students will be hosted by our university" • 目的表述： o 两种写法： ▪ "This notice is for the purpose of introducing... and calling for..." ▪ "This notice is to introduce... and recruit..." o 志愿者数量：可自由设定（如25/35 名），题干无限制 • 活动详情： o 时间安排："The camp is scheduled to begin on June 25 and last for about..." o 活动内容：重点写学术讲座和校园参观两类核心活动 • 志愿者要求： o 校园向导："Applicants should be familiar with our campus" o 附加能力："able to guide participants during spare time" o 语言要求："capable of speaking at least one foreign language"（视参与者情况）

examples.pageText: 参考范文： Notice Friday, June 10 We are quite pleased to hear that a summer camp for high school students will be hosted by our university. Then this notice is to introduce the camp activities and calling for 25 volunteers. To begin with/First of all =Above all =Firstly, this camp is scheduled to start on June 25 and last (for) approximately /About two weeks. In addition, since a majority of/ a large proportion of the participants are not so familiar with our university, it is appropriate and advisable for applicants to know the campus well and show them around in the spare time such as visiting the history museum of our university. Then/Most importantly,, major activities are lectures or courses(which are)given by well-known /famous/notable=prestigious professors, experts or scholars. Of course, other sports and fun competitions will be included. Thus, volunteers are supposed to have/own=possess=boast certain experience and ability in organizing activities. Finally, there will be an interview for applicants in the Office of the Student Union at 14:00 on June 16. The Students’ Union 参考译文： 通知 星期五，6 月10 日 我们很高兴听说我校将要举办一次针对高中生的夏令营。那么，本通知的目的是为该夏 令营招募25 名志愿者。 首先，本次夏令营将于6 月25 日开始并持续两星期。此外，因为很多参与者对我们这 所大学不熟悉，申请人应该熟悉校园并在业余时间带他们四处转转，比如，参观校史馆。然 后，主要活动是由知名教授或学者所做的讲座或课程。当然，其他体育活动和趣味竞赛也包 含在内。因此，志愿者在组织活动方面应该具有一定经验和能力。 最后，在6 月16 日14:00 学生会办公室有一个针对申请人的面试 学生会 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: 18 年英二：邀请+说明 Directions: Suppose you have to cancel your travel plan and will not be able to visit Professor Smith. Write him an email to 1) apologize and explain the situation; 2) suggest a future meeting. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) attend v.出席 the graduation ceremony 毕业典礼 • 背景分析： o cancel travel plan 应理解为"出行计划"而非"旅行计划"，因涉及拜访教授 o 拜访教授目的通常为学术交流（谈论文/作业），非私人活动 • 写作要求： o 邮件需包含道歉和情况说明 o 需提出未来会面建议 • 易错点： o 混淆travel plan 的具体含义 o 忽略邮件格式要求 o 未完整包含题目要求的三个要点 参考范文： Dear Professor Smith, I am quite/ much/really/exceedingly/particularly/deeply/very grateful / thankful/obliged/indebted for your invitation to talk about my paper / thesis/exam and I planned/intended to go. However, I have to cancel my travel plan. So, I am writing to apologize and the reason. As you know during the past year, I have been exceedingly busy since I devoted/ allocated nearly all time and energy to preparing for the national entrance examination for postgraduate studies/ the postgraduate entrance exam. Unfortunately, I am so careless that today, I noticed that the day for the test is just the date (when)I planned to visit you. Thus, I have no choice/ option but to abandon/ cancel / call off my plan and please/ I truly hope that you stand in my shoes to accept my apologies. Finally, I deem that it is advisable for me to visit you immediately after the test.(Once again, sorry for any inconvenience caused.) Yours sincerely Li Ming 参考译文： 尊敬的史密斯教授： 非常感谢您邀请我去谈我的论文，而且我本打算去。然而我不得不取消出行计划，所以， 我写信想要致歉并说明原因。
examples.en: Directions: Suppose you have to cancel your travel plan and will not be able to visit Professor Smith. Write him an email to 1) apologize and explain the situation; 2) suggest a future meeting. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. So, I am writing to apologize and the reason. Unfortunately, I am so careless that today, I noticed that the day for the test is just the date (when)I planned to visit you. I truly hope that you stand in my shoes to accept my apologies. Finally, I deem that it is advisable for me to visit you immediately after the test. Once again, sorry for any inconvenience caused.

examples.pageText: 19 年英二：建议+说明 Directions: Suppose Professor Smith asked you to plan a debate on the theme of city traffic. Write him an email to 1) suggest a specific topic with your reasons, and 2) tell him about your arrangements You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) debate n.辩论 on n.关于 theme n.主题 traffic n.交通 topic n.话题 arrangements 安排 • 写作要求： o 为Smith 教授策划关于城市交通主题的辩论 o 内容包括：建议主题及理由、具体安排 o 落款使用"Zhang Wei"代替真名 • 审题要点： o 题材识别：明确是电子邮件写作，属于应用文范畴 o 背景分析：学术场景下与教授的正式沟通 o 内容要求：必须包含主题建议（含理由）和安排说明两个核心部分 o 格式规范：注意邮件格式和署名要求 • 写作步骤： o 时间分配：建议总用时18 分钟（审题2-3 分钟+写作15 分钟） o 首段构成：应包含收到邀请的感谢+邮件目的说明 o 主题选择：需与城市交通相关且有可辩性（如"限制还是鼓励私家车"） o 理由展开：可从经济发展与交通拥堵的矛盾关系切入 • 注意事项： o 主题禁忌：避免选择无需辩论的主题（如"是否遵守交通规则"） o 语言风格：保持正式学术语气，避免口语化表达 o 结构完整：需包含引言、主体（理由+安排）、结尾三部分 • 示范框架： o 称呼（Dear Professor Smith） o 首段：感谢邀请+表明写作目的 o 主体段：建议主题（如私家车政策）+2-3 个支持理由 o 安排段：辩论时间、地点、流程等具体规划 o 结尾段：期待回复+礼貌结束语

examples.pageText: 参考范文： Dear Professor Smith, I'm quite/very/much/really/particularly/exceedingly/pretty pleased /glad/excited/happy/delighted to receive your invitation to plan a debate on the theme of city traffic.Today,I am writing for the purpose of sharing my ideas about the tpopic and arrangements. I deem/hold/reckon/contend/believe that it is advisable for us to choose this topic:Private Cars-to Encourage or to Limit/To Encourage or Restrict Private Cars? I have two reasons / There are two reasons. For one thing, in recent years, China has been characterized by the economic boom and prosperity,which has enabled a growing/an increasing number of families to possess additional incomes to purchase private cars. Admittedly,/Definitely,/Undoubtedly/With no doubt, private cars bring/give peopletremendous convenience.For another, it is too many private cars thatcause increasingly serious traffic jams problems/congestion. Finally, this debate is scheduled/ arranged/planned to start at 19:00 on June 20 in the Student Activity Center and last(for)approximately2 hours.(Of course, if you have any better suggestions or requirements, please feel free to inform me.) Yours sincerely Li Ming 参考译文： 尊敬的史密斯教授： 我很高兴收到您让我策划城市交通为主题的辩论的邀请。今天，我写信目的是分享我的 我关于话题和安排的一些想法。 我认为，我们应该选择这个主题：私家车---是限制还是鼓励？有两个原因。一方面，近 些年来，中国的突出特征就在于经济的蓬勃和繁荣，这使得越来越多的家庭有了额外的收入 来购买私家车。不得不承认，私家车给人们带来巨大的方便。另一方面，也正是过多的私家 车导致了越来越严重的交通堵塞 最后，本次辩论计划于6 月20 日19:00 在学生活动中心开始，并持续约2 小时。（当 然，如果您有其他任何更好的建议，请务必告知我。） 谨上 李明 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题

examples.pageText: 20 年英二：说明+提醒 Directions: Suppose you are planning a tour of a historical site for a group of international students 1) tell them about the site, and 2) give them some tips for the tour You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) • 题干分析: o 假设句: "Suppose you are planning a tour" ▪ "tour"可理解为旅行或游览 ▪ "historical site"指历史景点 o 对象: "a group of international students"(留学生群体) o 要求: ▪ 介绍景点("tell them about the site") ▪ 提供建议("give them some tips") • 写作体裁: 未明确说明，默认为书信形式 • 易错点: o 过度纠结正式程度 o 忽略题干中的关键动词(planning, tell, give) 参考范文： Dear friends, I'm quite/very/much/really/particularly/exceedingly/pretty pleased /glad/excited/happy/delighted to hear that you have arrived in Beijing, the capital of China.Today, I'm writing for the purpose of introducing our tour of a historical site. Beijing is a modern city, but it is also characterized by the time-honored history. Thus, I deem that it is advisable for us to visit the famous /renowned/well-known Great Wall which can bring/give us opportunities to appreciate/enjoy Chinese ancient distinctive /special/unique architectures/ buildings, inspire our passion for China's history, and enable us to enjoy/view the surrounding natural beauties /landscapes/scenery. In addition,I have two tips:take your cameras and do not litter. (What is more, this tour is scheduled to start at 8:00 on June 20th) near the gate of our hotel and last for approximately 5 hours. So, my tip is "to take your passport and not be late.) Finally, I hope that you can enjoy a comfortable and fruitful trip. Yours sincerely Li Ming

examples.pageText: 22 年英二：邀请+说明 Directions: Suppose you are planning a campus food festival. Write an email to the international students in your university to 1) introduce the food festival, and 2) invite them to participate You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use “Li Ming” instead. Do not write the address. (10 points) 参考范文： Dear Sir or Madam/friends=boys and girls, As the chairman of the Student Union/Students’ Union at/in this university who is in charge of/responsible for organizing the upcoming/forthcoming campus food festival, I am writing for the purpose of introducing relevant details and inviting you to participate/participate in/attend=join it. First of all/Above all=To begin with=First, this festival is scheduled to/is planned/arranged/going to/will start at 11:00 on January 15 in the Center of Students’ Activities and last(for)approximately 3 hours. In addition/Additionally=Besides=What is more=Furthermore, if you are good at cooking, you are supposed to/it is advisable for you to show your cooking skills/talent. Of course, if you are keen on=like/love=be fond of tasty/delicious food(s), it is exceedingly necessary for you to come and taste/enjoy Chinese and foreign dishes. In a word, this festival will bring you joy/delight/happiness, inspire your passion for food culture, and help you make new friends. Meanwhile, we deem that this festival will bring/give you opportunities to make new friends, inspire your passion for food culture,and help you relax. 尾段一：Finally, we are convinced that with your participation and support this festival will be successful and fabulous. 尾段二：Finally, if you have any other questions,suggestions or requireme pleasts feel free to inform us. examples.pageText: Li Ming 参考译文： 尊敬的杰克： 很高兴获悉我们将要一起搞一个关于乌镇老房子保护的调查。今天，邮件目的是谈谈我 的计划并寻求你的建议。 首先，我认为我们应该在当地居民中开展这项调查，因为与其人相比，他们对老房子状 况的细节了解更多。此外，在这项调查中，我们应该收集建筑师的建议，这将会带给我们专 业洞察力，激发我们对这项工作的热情，并帮助更多人意识到保护老房子的重要性。 选写：另外，这项调查计划于6 月20 日在乌镇开始并持续约一星期。 尾段一：最后，如果你有其他任何建议或邀请，请务必告知我。 尾段二：最后，我相信在我们的共同努力之下，这项调查将会是富有成果且成功的 尾段三：最后，我期待着你方便的时候给与正面的回应。 谨上 李明 请按以下“7 步法”背写本节课的范文并背写讲义范文的生词： 抄写英文——英译汉——汉译英——对比找差别——专门背写出错或差异之处——背写 全文至无错——思考每句话如何用来写其他话题
